strings.GNG_work_smarter_desc: To truly excel in the modern marketplace and rise past any and all competition, thinking outside of the box that is mainstream corporate thought is increasingly necessary. With this in mind, the Chief Executive has ordered the beginning of integration of the economy of Guangdong with the most modern computers available, to give us a huge advantage over our competitors in an emerging and increasingly profitable industry.
strings.GNG_uncountable_accountants_desc:
Computers, amazing as they are, still cannot come close to being as effective as human beings - or at least, that would be the case had reality been more generous. All their boundless intellectual potential aside humans remain simply far too susceptible to sloth, corruption, and an irritating propensity for material fulfillment as is the case past and present - all mortal vices beneath the metal, infallible heart of the machine.

Computers, after all, are physically incapable of bribery, of incessant demands for “wages”, or of slacking off on tasks requiring undivided dedication. There will be a tomorrow where humanity ascends to true enlightment; meanwhile automation, not mere bone and flesh, shall be our today. And an automated Guangdong will be what Ibuka and his lieutenants at Fujitsu strive towards, starting now.
strings.GNG_uncountable_accountants_tt: Why rely on fallible - or corruptible - humans when you could have a perfect machine?
strings.GNG_offer_an_alternative_desc: Fujitsu and its associates are well-informed of the limitations of human intellectual capability; the other corporations, evidently less so. As a response Ibuka and his army of statisticians shall distribute questionnaires and collect office reports, with the intent to demonstrate the deficiencies and drawbacks of manual white-collar labor in as comprehensive and accessible a manner as possible. If the obviously miserable state of our bureaucracy can't make those clueless board corporates see the necessity of an automated workforce, then cold hard data certainly will.
strings.GNG_test_the_throughput_desc:
Weeks of labor from our brightest minds has borne fruit in the form of a new, cutting-edge line of computers: every module a culmination of engineering ingenuity, a soldier of impenetrable iron awaiting deployment into Guangdong's offices and workshops.

Like with any good soldier, however, intensive training is indispensable. The time has come to bring the machines out of our warehouses and process them through meticulously prepared trials, jotting down parameters, time intervals, and each and every room for improvement along the way - guaranteeing that the service of our automated administrators to the citizenry will be of unmatched quality.
strings.GNG_meet_your_new_coworker_desc:
With great change comes greater backlash, and Guangdong's ongoing revolution is no exception. Due to the scope and comprehensiveness of administrative computerization we predict a significant surge in disgruntled office workers, especially those directly targeted by the incoming overhaul.

And we shall nip the discontent in the bud, through the injection of expertly crafted, equally informative and entertaining advertisement pieces into the veins of state media. By plastering TVs and billboards with our message we will keep those hapless pen-pushers distracted and enraptured by the omnipotence of the machine and the enticing future it promises - then swiftly and stealthily wipe all their names from the contract, a final cleanup for the advent of our automated workers. At least no one can say we're lying.
strings.GNG_meet_your_new_coworker_tt: And may they be an example - and make examples - of us all.
strings.GNG_a_question_of_infrastructure_desc:
Guangdong's infrastructure, while currently adequate, is ill-suited for the Chief Executive's ambitious plans. Luckily, Fujitsu has at its disposal an impressive selection of electronic hardware, perfectly suited for an ambitious modernization of Guangdong's infrastructure.

New wires, cables, and servers will lay the groundwork for Guangdong's future development, the foundations of a new “silicon revolution” in the Three Pearls.

The tidy profit turned by making Guangdong reliant on Fujitsu's hardware won't hurt at all.
strings.GNG_a_question_of_infrastructure_tt: An automaton is only as smart as we program it to be. Human ingenuity is boundless - if we set it loose in a digital frontier.
strings.GNG_one_language_desc:
The infant field of computing has already seen the rise of several different programming languages throughout the developed world. COBOL and AIMACO in the United States, and ALSPRA in Germany. To compete with these rival superpowers, Guangdong will need its own programming language.

ShoGen has already made inroads into Guangdong as the programming language of Fujitsu Limited. Standardizing on ShoGen will help ease future development and provide a common framework for new improvements.

The leg-up this gives Fujitsu is simply an added benefit.
strings.GNG_emphasize_interconnectivity_desc:
As we push the development of electronic and digital technology, we must be diligent against the proliferation of incompatible systems. Such occurrences will only place obstacles in our ability to develop Guangdong's electronic industry and hamper our efficiency.

The Chief Executive has, to this end, placed heavy emphasis on ensuring that all Fujitsu hardware is as compatible as possible. This will help ensure future interconnectivity and guarantee increased efficiency in the area of information sharing and financial transfers.
strings.GNG_a_digital_foundation_desc:
As a result of our efforts to build up our electronic infrastructure, the Chief Executive now feels confident enough to push for a bold new initiative. The movement of Fujitsu Limited's data and services into a completely digital space.

The novel initiative will not only cement Fujistu's place as one of the most innovative companies within the Sphere but will set an example for our rivals in the Three Pearls. Soon, Sony and Matsushita will be itching to move their operations into the digital world, on electronics and servers built by Fujitsu.
strings.GNG_a_digital_foundation_tt: The future shall be written in bytes and code, not just silicon and copper.
strings.GNG_the_guangdong_efficiency_ordinance_d:
Yet another test of our competence has come. The Efficiency Ordinance, the pinnacle of our recent efforts, aims to implement computer installation quotas upon all businesses within our borders as an additional prerequisite for legal status. Its benefit comes threefold: the elimination of stagnant small businesses with inadequate funding, the massive boost in Fujitsu's own revenue as it generously provides society with computerized equipment, and the optimization of state management and production.

All in all it is poised to be another enormous leap towards Guangdong's brilliant destiny - provided, of course, that the other representatives in the Legislative Council give up on their haughtiness and be cooperative for once...
strings.GNG_work_harder_desc: The functioning of the combined productive forces of Guangdong remains at the forefront of Ibuka's mind, but currently production is not up to expectations, and growth is struggling to keep up with increasing costs. To correct this issue, we will bring the force of science and technology to bear on the gaps in productivity to increase both profits and efficiency and modernize the practices of our business.
strings.GNG_repurpose_nonproductive_land_desc:
There are significant tracts of undeveloped and unused land spread between the Three Pearls, areas filled with unproductive slums, rundown industrial facilities, and undeveloped fields. Having gone underutilized by the Suzuki administration, Ibuka has come up with a new scheme to turn these areas into a new industrial center. One capable of competing with even Manchukuo's vast industrial machine.

To begin with, these backward estates will be bought up by Guangdong's Corporations to be cleared out and developed into new productive industrial establishments and housing complexes. Those displaced will simply have to find accommodation elsewhere.
strings.GNG_industrial_urban_integration_desc:
While Fujitsu Limited may be mostly focused on electronics, there is no reason why we cannot apply our efficiency and innovation to the field of real estate.

As part of efforts to build up Guangdong's industry, Fujitsu will begin the construction of new worker tenements near planned industrial establishments. These gigantic buildings will adequately house the large numbers of low paid laborers needed in our factories at a reasonable cost. After all, we're not Manchukuo, and we have no interest in working our laborers to death.
strings.GNG_the_steel_belt_desc:
Our pieces are in place, with the land bought up and the tenements ready, we can finally begin the process of building an industry capable of competing with Manchukuo. Central to this effort will be the creation of a new “Steel Belt” between the Three Pearls. An economic and industrial center from which capital, labor, and material can be harnessed and exploited.

The Chief Executive, Guangdong, and Fujitsu will throw their full weight behind the project, utilizing every personal favor, connection, and resource at their disposal. We shall offer tax breaks, and incentives, whatever it takes, for if Guangdong is to establish itself as the Sphere's place to do business, we can spare no expense.
strings.GNG_a_different_kind_of_brilliance_desc:
Honkon and Makao are cesspits, hubs of the decadence and hedonism that saw the Western order swept away on the Japanese tide. Even now, the old families of the two cities lounge across the entertainment industry like walruses, parasites on the local economy. Yet, for all their resemblance to Sodom and Gomorrah, the financial muscle these cities have built up over their long history is formidable, and essential for our purposes.

We will further develop our initiatives to bring in investments from all across the Sphere and even further beyond, all while giving the vice cities a once-over to make them a little more appealing. Though we recognize the danger they pose to our project, pragmatism must, in this case, prevail.
strings.GNG_new_pearls_for_a_new_era_desc:
Ibuka and Fujitsu stand for innovation above all else. A new way of doing things, one that gets rid of the inefficiencies and the bloat of yesteryear. And there is no greater symbol of bloat and inefficiency in Guangdong than Honkon and Makao.

Honkon's financial sector, packed with loan sharks and overleveraged retail banks, is a dark spot on our creditworthiness. Makao's vice industries make us the laughing stock of the Sphere. But, with enough investment, the cities will become home to thriving tech industries - with Fujitsu front and center. Soon enough, the Pearls will be tech hubs on the level of Kōshū itself.
strings.GNG_raw_materials_for_the_sphere_desc:
As the demands of the current business cycle come to the forefront, the Chief Executive has decided that the focus of the Steel Belt will, for now, be focused on the processing of raw materials for re-export throughout the Sphere.

While does this little to wean us off our dependency on Tokyo, it will help in the development of the Steel Belt, spurning investment and expansion as our industries take in and send out the bounty of the Southern Resource Area.
strings.GNG_our_own_components_desc:
As the demands of the current business cycle come to the forefront, the Chief Executive has decided that the focus of the Steel Belt will, for now, be focused on the production and fabrication of electronic components for Guangdong's burgeoning electronics industry.

While this will certainly slow down the rate of growth within our industries, it will reduce our dependence on Tokyo and allow Guangdong greater independence, if at the cost of slowing the development of the Steel Belt as our industry specializes.
strings.GNG_build_on_what_we_have_desc: Every day, the fast developing economies of the world draw ever closer to energy and resource self-sufficiency, and we cannot afford to fall behind. To this end, we will fine-tune our petroleum extraction and oil refinery techniques and makes every last drop of it count, to draw out of other places the oil that Guangdong lacks in the first place yet so desperately needs. For this to be possible, we will need the ingenuity of our engineers to devise these improved techniques, and to instill ever greater discipline into our workers to make the improvements they design into reality. We cannot fail, for failure is to find ourselves at the mercy of others to satisfy our energy demands, and such mercy is always a fickle thing.
strings.GNG_look_out_for_the_unexpected_desc: Creativity can come from the most unexpected places, and sometimes it can be useful to step outside one's own perspective to become inspired. Renewable energy is certainly one solution to our severe energy needs, but the technology for it is still nascent and yet to be fully realized. Investing resources into commercial solar panels and turbines that generate energy from the wind itself would be a deeply innovative experiment venturing into largely unknown ground- and yet, it is a challenge that our scientists are more than capable of handling. All the better if the achievements they make in the field of renewable energy give us a headstart over others across the globe.
strings.GNG_the_workshops_ablaze_desc:
The weeks of frenzied development and rapid expansion has come to a close as the current business cycle comes to an end. As the last orders are fulfilled, and delays ironed out, workers, supervisors, and managers take in sighs of relief.

Guangdong's industries have grown and expanded in these recent months and the workshops, factories, and furnaces around the Three Pearls are already gearing up for the next wave of contracts.

For the market doesn't rest, and neither will we.
strings.GNG_the_workshops_ablaze_tt: The fire of innovation burns hotter and brighter than ever.
strings.GNG_on_to_bigger_things_desc:
As Guangdong's economy roars back to life, the Chief Executive is now finally free to focus on his own personal dream. The creation and development of institutions where men like Ibuka and fellow talented and like-minded engineers can be left to tinker on their own, and given time and resources, produce marvels for all the world to see.

For the cultivation of bright young minds will not only help ensure Fujitsu's future but that of all of Guangdong.
strings.GNG_on_to_bigger_things_tt: The brain must work as hard as our hands, or else £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong will lose its luster.
strings.GNG_establish_research_parks_desc:
Guangdong will need facilities for its bright and talented if they are to forge our future. To this end, the creation of new research parks to hone intelligent young minds and bring them in contact with like-minded fellows is an obvious and necessary move.

And as an added benefit, these facilities will allow Fujitsu the first pick of Guangdong's best and brightest prodigies.
strings.GNG_form_the_commitee_of_technology_desc:
Every day new start-ups are formed in Guangdong from ambitious, innovative, and talented entrepreneurs. It is a sad fact that most of these start-ups fail. While often this is due to mistakes and failures to the entrepreneurs themselves, all too often, promising ventures are cut short by circumstances outside of their control. The Chief, however, just happens to have a solution.

The Committee of Technology aims to rectify this shortcoming. With a mandate to seek out, identify, and fund promising tech start-ups and encourage innovation and creativity with awards. The Committee will ensure that those who deserve to succeed will succeed.
strings.GNG_in_the_business_of_ingenuity_desc:
Guangdong's new industry is building the future. Or, more accurately, the invention of technological advances, advances that are then patented for future use. It is an industry fuelled by the minds of the Three Pearls and those of Fujitsu Limited, forged by Chief Executive Ibuka Masaru and supported by Sphere's resources. A beating heart of technology, industry, and talent.

The future is coming, and it will be built in Guangdong.
strings.GNG_in_the_business_of_ingenuity_tt: And Fujitsu shines brightest of all...
strings.GNG_license_out_production_desc:
Guangdong is building the future, and it is only fair that we share our advances, for a price, of course. The Chief Executive has approved the licensing of Fujitsu patents to companies across the Sphere, and the projected earnings are eye-watering, especially given the advantageous terms demanded.

While limiting the demand for our products, and despite (or because of) our hard bargains, calls are flooding in, from Tokyo to Shōnan, from Nanjing to Manila all eager to get their hands on Fujitsu's patents. After all, the future is here, all you have to do is license it.
strings.GNG_license_out_production_tt: ...and its light illuminates every other nation in Asia.
strings.GNG_in_house_secrets_desc:
Guangdong will build the future, and the rest of the world will have to wait for its turn. The Chief Executive has denied the licensing of Fujitsu patents to separate companies, leaving the task of producing and utilizing patent designs solely in the hands of Fujitsu Limited.

While limiting possible earnings, it has certainly kept Fujitsu's products flying off the shelves. Demand is high, and supply is low as buyers from Tokyo to Shōnan eagerly await the chance to buy products from Guangdong. After all, the future is for sale, all you have to do is catch it.
strings.GNG_the_guangdong_trademark_ordinance_de:
The Guangdong Trademark Ordinance is the final piece needed to finally ensure the position of both Fujitsu Limited and the Chief Executive in the Three Pearls.

Creating stringent copyright laws, the passage of the GTO would solidify Fujitsu's control over its newly patented technical developments. And would grant Ibuka the ability to pursue extremely damaging lawsuits against any who would think to use patented designs without prior knowledge or permission from Fujitsu Limited.

Its successful passage will firmly entrench our dominance over our rivals in the Three Pearls.
strings.GNG_addressing_workforce_defects_desc: The workforce of Guangdong is indolent and unruly. They serve as one of the most evident illustrations of the inept sloth and apathy that are harbored by the human consciousness, decadence that hinders the advancement of progress. The truly gifted, the talented, the men who possess ability and capability are prevented from escalating up the ranks due to the millions of incapable cretins who enforce their counterproductive culture. This inimical culture will end. Fujitsu will be cleansed of inability, which will be followed by the other corporations of Guangdong. The culture must be exterminated, as it serves no benefit to us and progress.
strings.GNG_addressing_workforce_defects_tt: A perfect machine, requires a perfect operator.
strings.GNG_10_point_scale_desc: There is no room for inadequacy in a corporation. The necessary procedures will be taken to ensure that the capabilities of our employees are measured with precision. The collected data will be used to assess the value of our workers, ensuring that absolutely no parasites or idlers may survive. If you are found to be incapable or apathetic, your demotion or removal will be swift and guaranteed, if the opposite is true, you will be rewarded accordingly. This ensures a workplace culture centered strictly upon a person's merits, for it is the only factor that assures efficiency. It does not matter how valiant your attempts are, statistics do not falter akin to human evaluation.
strings.GNG_empower_managers_desc: In order to increase and maximize employee efficiency and encourage the beneficial innovation of truly gifted employees, supervision is unconditional and essential. The thousands of workers occupying the offices of Guangdong's complexes require guiding hands that ensure their efficiency. The capable men bequeathed with managerial positions will receive increased privileges and jurisdiction over the men below them, further augmenting their authority over the colony of ants. No longer will the system be shattered and bypassed, undoubtedly creating an environment where the merits and talents of the exceptional will thrive and flourish from the enterprises.
strings.GNG_eliminate_downtime_desc: We have learned that far too many of our workers aren't actually working while on the clock. After looking into the causes of this, it appears to be the result of 'downtime', where workers will talk to their friends or rest rather than focusing on being productive. To combat this practice, we will physically separate friends at the workplace, move workers to busier areas in production to prevent slacking, and remove unauthorized time off from pay. With this, they will quickly learn that when they are in the workplace, our profits should be their priority.
strings.GNG_punish_mediocrity_desc: In order to bring Guangdong together into a new age of brilliance and technological advancement, mediocrity at any and all levels can no longer be tolerated. Every employee of Fujitsu, from the lowest to the highest, must perform at levels of excellence that other corporations only dream of achieving. So that this can be brought into effect, any misdemeanor, every slight, all inefficiency and above all any show of merely average or even below average ability will be punished with wage reductions, suspension from promotions, and even termination. Whether they want to or not, all our workers will learn to be the best at their jobs in the world.
strings.GNG_recognize_excellence_desc: To ensure continued excellence, current excellence must be appropriately and swiftly rewarded. People must be encouraged when they show adaptability and talent in order for them to truly shine. These are the ideals of Fujitsu, which was and remains a company led by the pioneers by today's industry. In accordance with our principles, the most efficient and capable workers and managers will be singled out and rewarded with bonuses and promotions. Along with ensuring the upper management is made up of intelligent and capable individuals, this practice will make every worker devote their time to being the most productive version of themselves that they can be.
strings.GNG_ending_inequity_desc:
For far too long, Fujitsu has passed on talented young minds for engineering and design positions. Not because of skill or capability, but on irrelevant classifications such as ethnicity and class. A practice that only served to harm our bottom line and breed complacency within our ranks.

No more. To foster innovation and combat stagnation, the Chief Executive has seen fit to begin a new initiative to seek out bright entrepreneurs and individuals, regardless of their background or social status. Imbuing new life in Fujitsu's engineering departments and deepening our talent pool.

After all, our engineers cannot be the best in the world if we are artificially limiting our talent pool.
strings.GNG_ending_inequity_tt: Never let it be said that £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Ibuka is unsympathetic to the commoner; if they have the ability, they should rise to the top.
strings.GNG_encourage_innovation_desc:
What better place to seek out innovation than amongst the lower classes? The Chinese populations dwelling amidst Guangdong's working-class have long been passed over in our efforts to recruit the best of the best.

To rectify this oversight, a new campaign will be launched to encourage innovation in our lower workplaces, seeking talented new engineers to fill our ranks. Most will, of course, fail horrendously given the lack of prior expertise and education, but the few who succeed will do so spectacularly.

We will, however, be passing over the Zhujin communities, who will be displeased at having to take up factory jobs instead of their usual management and administrative positions.
strings.GNG_the_churn_desc:
We will seek out our new engineers from the ranks of our middle managers, the Zhujin, who predominantly occupy administrative and supervisory roles.

These bureaucrats will be rotated through a series of different positions and roles to gauge their effectiveness and creativity. Innovation will be encouraged, but only in a closely controlled setting with significant oversight.

While beneficial to the Zhujin, the Chinese lower class will be... displeased at our favoritism.
strings.GNG_talent_search_desc:
Our initiatives have begun to show their first results, but we cannot pass over our own overlooked minds within Fujitsu. A thorough search for talent and expertise within the company will be conducted to find anyone who may have been missed in our race to the top.

These prospective minds will join the growing ranks of our engineering department. Soon, Fujitsu's engineers will be known worldwide for their talent and skill, for whom no problem is too difficult.

After all, we are Guangdong's best.
strings.GNG_the_guangdong_organized_labor_ordina:
While the Suzuki administration had seen fit press for inefficient and disruptive labor legislation in the lead up to the Yasuda crash, Ibuka has brought a much more rational mind to the Chief Executive's Office. And with Guangdong's workforce deficits finally being addressed, Ibuka has now seen fit to propose legislation to correct Suzuki's mistakes.

The proposed Guangdong Organized Labor Ordinance will learn from the Revised Labor Standards Ordinance's folly and streamline labor laws to acceptable standards. A definitive improvement over existing laws, the passage of the Ordinance would do much to improve the efficiency and productivity of our workers.

Of course, such legislation will not go over well with the lower classes, who view our legislation as an attempt to limit their privileges and rights.
strings.GNG_grow_our_own_brains_desc:
The beacon of innovation shines ever brighter across the globe, salvaged from collapse by Ibuka's visionary embrace and renovated by Fujitsu's unmatched intellect - yet at its foundation glaring fissures remain. Illiteracy, education shortages - two fatal ills in the system that have evaded our attention for too long, heinously band-aided by rampant outsourcing.

How is one to direct his path towards destiny, when his own vehicle refuses to obey its master? How is Guangdong to remodel itself as the brain of the world, if its very neurons - prized intellectuals and their creations - remain in the clutches of dimwitted outsiders? Intellectual autarky, above all else, shall be the key to unshackle our march of progress; and through decisive initiatives we shall give rise to a fresh stream of new scholars and researchers, cultivated by Guangdong and for Guangdong.
strings.GNG_grow_our_own_brains_tt: It's not enough to hire the engineers of today; we must cultivate the geniuses of tomorrow. We shall spare no expense to those found worthy.
strings.GNG_kindergarten_is_too_late_desc:
The keystone of universal education is, in fact, children. The brain of a child, as Ibuka has discovered, possesses truly fascinating qualities - compact yet tremendously capable of information storage and retention, it is a sponge in the most literal sense, with its malleability regrettably decaying with age.

As such the sooner our youngsters are educated, the better. A new line of early school programs is to be implemented at Fujitsu, where the children of our employees are expected to have their first taste of the future; with our very own men as contributors to the experiment, in weeks at most the entirety of Guangdong will be introduced to true state-of-the-art education taking human potential to unprecedented heights. And by then whatever naysayers remaining will only have blinded themselves to one simple fact: kindergarten is just too late.
strings.GNG_unlimited_input_desc:
Better yet, the immense malleability of a child's brain before it falls into rust makes it the all-too-perfect vessel of innumerable data, formulas, algorithms - too precious a goldmine to have gone untapped by those excuses for educators before us.

Let it be our inalienable duty to pump the treasure trove of truth into our next generation and gift them with fully condensed class schedules, copious reading supplements, and hands-on practical sessions, starting within the very comforts of Fujitsu facilities. Bleeding hearts outside can whine however they want that we're “frying” the brains of our children; it truly is a pity those people are too much of a horde of neanderthals to know better.
strings.GNG_diversity_in_learning_desc:
Better yet, the immense malleability of a child's brain before it falls into rust makes it the all-too-perfect vessel for a whole rotunda of talents. Creative arts, oratory skills, physical education, all indispensable ingredients for the perfect Guangdong man - as flexible as he is durable, ready to serve Guangdong on command and provide whatever is required of him.

It is to this end that our experimental school shall be geared towards, through the implementation of rigorous, mandatory extracurricular programs as criteria for academic evaluations. Let our classrooms henceforth rid themselves of monotonous methodology, for an all-round future is always better than a rigidified one.
strings.GNG_make_up_lost_time_desc:
Adults, on the other hand... suffice to say they've marched well past the crossroads of life. The gears of the mind have been locked dead into place, grinding on with mere inertia as the rest of the brain descends into rust year after year until, finally, the whole machine would crawl to a permanent halt.

But there's never too much we can do to keep the gears turning. Guangdong's intellectual rehabilitation is already well underway, and our very own men at Fujitsu shall lead the charge - through mandatory enrollment in employee institutions, where even the plainest of laborers will find themselves rearmed and revitalized with mathematical and scientific discipline. It isn't just about corporate dominance; it's about keeping our nation's destiny firmly within our palm.
strings.GNG_off_the_clock_desc: So begins the rekindling of the Guangdong spirit. Ibuka himself has purged the very concept of recreation from his dictionary; needless to say his lieutenants at Fujitsu, Guangdong's very nexus of innovation, are expected to follow suit. No longer will redundant, inane “spare time” be allowed to clog up our schedule and leave our minds to untimely rot; between shifts, meals, and bed hours only the most refined of academic workshops and laboratories will remain, chiseling the thirst for knowledge back into the rusting brains of our workers, blow by blow.
strings.GNG_on_the_job_desc: So begins the rebirth of the Guangdong mind. From the assembly line to the lab bench, even the most uninformed of our men shall be accompanied by the finest of learning supplements and the wisest of instructors. While our men keep their hands occupied, their minds would already be ascending, slowly but surely, up the gleaming stairways of academia. This is how, complemented by Fujitsu education institutes, they shall forge themselves into as much learned laborers as practical thinkers: beacons of diligence and wisdom to inspire the rest of Guangdong's labor force, and the perfect flag bearers of our future.
strings.GNG_cutting_edge_institutions_desc:
So what is to be the classroom if not the eden of knowledge, of academic enlightenment and inheritance? What is to be the classroom, if not the fulcrum upon which our nation would stand wise and tall and embrace, with pride in its heart, the vault of heaven glimmering with splendor from above?

There is no other answer - Ibuka knows, and so do we. And the ultimate truth has been encrusted within the institutions we at Fujitsu have perfected with such peerless wisdom and dedication, all of them pinnacles of pedagogy and human intellect. All of Guangdong's kindergartens, elementary schools, high schools, and universities shall follow in our footsteps, and we will mandate them so. In no time the neurons beneath our soil shall spring back to life teeming with signals of modernity; the brain of Guangdong will return to our hands, and ours alone.
strings.GNG_a_gift_to_the_masses_desc:
Yes, the Chinese are the ones to swarm the most rock-bottom of our factories and yes, it certainly is tempting to simply leave them to their own devices; but to dismiss them as mere imbeciles swamped in perpetual destitution is to blatantly overlook the sheer manpower of seventy percent of Guangdong's aggregate population, and the untapped goldmine of intellectual potential that comes with them.

A machine without its innumerable cogs cannot function, doubly so for a nation striving to get back on its feet. Let the pristine halls of our universities open its embrace to the intellectually deprived Chinese masses, not merely as oases of knowledge, but as blazing, howling blast furnaces of devotion and self-betterment those people will throw themselves into for the greater good of Guangdong.
strings.GNG_privilege_is_priceless_desc:
The matter of Chinese education is simply too much of a headache. A whopping seventy percent of Guangdong's aggregate population, with average literacy rate magnitudes below even that of the common Zhujin middleman - an insoluble quagmire beyond salvage by even the best of Ibuka's expertise.

Any attempt at uplifting those brutish masses will prove a bottomless pit of funds and energy. Universities will remain a privilege to Japanese expatriates and outstanding Zhujin, a hard failsafe against irrevocable degradation of our higher education institutions. Let those perpetually rotting away in low-end factories ask themselves: do they deserve better?
strings.GNG_the_guangdong_education_ordinance_de: It is time for us to put the icing on the cake of our recent endeavors. The future the Guangdong Education Ordinance presents is one of boundless promise, where all existing curricula within our borders are up-to-date and up-to-standard, and where only aspiring minds with sufficient education qualifications may cross the threshold and access prestigious careers. No longer will diplomas merely be tokens of vanity, framed or pinned on collars; from now on it is to be a basis of merit, a gauge of character, and an indicator of each and every citizen's place within our uncompromising march of progress.
strings.GNG_the_perfect_man_desc:
When all is said and done, however, all the books and cutting-edge institutions, all the external knowledge in the world will remain just that, external, if we can't root out the crux of our woes - ourselves.

It hurts, because it's true. We understand that humanity has always had an inherent propensity for comfort. We understand it's all too easy for the average person to toss away his aspirations, have a good, long yawn, then sink back into the warm embrace of self-satisfaction the first chance he gets. “I'm just not good enough”. “I don't see any way out of this”. “I didn't choose to be born into rags”. Such are the go-to excuses he would gladly cower behind, and we understand.

What we don't understand is why some of us would rather spend literal hours wallowing in a corner, than use those same hours into picking up a book or a manual. Why some of us would rather wait for things to “change for the better”, than step up and be the change they want to see in this world. It is proaction, the constant upwards drive, that human brilliance is made of; not sloth, not reaction, and certainly not opportunities bottled up in jars labeled “Japanese” or “Chinese”, sitting on a shelf, waiting for your most-sacred hand to choose.

Because the perfect man doesn't choose. He takes.
strings.GNG_the_perfect_man_tt: To truly be masters of the future, we must reshape the present - and we must make no compromises, no half-measures to coddle the unready.
strings.GNG_expunge_the_impoverished_desc:
There are too many neighborhoods filled with decaying shanties, sunken sidewalks, and crumbling apartments. Large families crammed into tenements, drifters curling up in alleyways, peddlers and panhandlers clogging every street. Some look at this mess and see “vibrance” and “authenticity.” Ibuka sees nothing but waste, the waste of perfectly good land.

It will all have to go, obviously. The hovels will be bulldozed, the streets will be leveled and properly drained, and the slate will be wiped clean for something better to come along.

“What about the residents?” the soft-hearted simpletons will cry. What about them? They're free to go, as long as they don't come back to stink up the new and improved neighborhoods.
strings.GNG_ultramodern_architecture_desc:
We cannot replace the buildings we just demolished with uninspired hunks of steel and cement. That would be simply cutting out a diseased organ and replacing it with a tumor. A better society must be built from the ground up, and that includes the very streets they walk on.

The best architects in Japan, even from outside Fujitsu if need be, shall be summoned and enlisted. Seventy years ago, American architects conceived of the “City Beautiful” movement. And now, it shall be a City Realized.
strings.GNG_cities_of_the_future_desc:
Things are running so much more smoothly now that construction has been underway. Like a powerful motor finally fitted to a suitable electricity source, our society can finally reach for its full potential now that its base has been improved. A beautiful city does create a beautiful society.

But architectural renewal is far from our final concern. For what good is a city without the bright minds that inhabit it, prosper within it, and bring in the revenue to sustain it?
strings.GNG_cities_of_the_future_tt: We shall rebuild £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong to be a beacon of neon in the darkness.
strings.GNG_our_own_intellectual_base_desc:
Though their heritage is Chinese, the Zhujin have proven themselves as loyal to Guangdong as any devoted Japanese resident. They are a dedicated, intelligent, industrious people who have succeeded where others failed, and they have further potential that has not yet been fully exploited. Thankfully, that may be unlucked with a surge of educational funding, to make sure that the brightest minds among their youth may stay bright through adulthood.

There are Japanese refugees and recent arrivals who may bellyache at this and say that we are turning our backs upon our own people, but if they think they are better than the Zhujin: prove it.
strings.GNG_a_new_life_in_guangdong_desc:
The Japanese refugees. Our brothers in blood from the Home Isles, driven by fate and ill circumstance into our arms. Though some are poor in wealth, they are all rich in intelligence, and are some of the best-educated people to be found in Guangdong. They can and will form the intellectual bedrock of our bureaucracy, our academia, our economy, and every other facet of the learned man's life.

The Zhujin, of course, will undoubtedly complain that they are being passed over, and that they will never be seen as equal to the Japanese. If any of them want that equality, they will have to earn it.
strings.GNG_the_guangdong_zoning_ordinance_desc:
One need only look at the human body to see that things work best when they are grouped together. Would the body be more efficient if one lung is inside the torso and the other is inside the left foot? Or if one eyeball was located under the armpit? Or if thumbs grew out of the forehead? Of course not!

This ordinance shall right such an error in the body politic. People shall live near those of the same profession, and when like is with like, all people within it shall work together with greater efficiency. No more conflicts of professional interest or spread of counterproductive ideals between fields, just pure, unadulterated focus. It may seem radical, but innovation is always a preferable alternative to stagnation.
strings.GNG_bugfixing_desc:
Guangdong's domestic situation has always been an issue, from ethnic tensions to rampant corruption, ineffectual police forces, and the ever-present problem of unorganized and organized crime. The heavy-handed and ultimately failed efforts by the Suzuki administration to tackle this problem have only served to drag down Guangdong.

Now in the Chief Executive's position, Ibuka's plans to “rectify” Guangdong's fault and succeed where his predecessors have failed. Through ingenuity, technology, and uncompromising efficiency, the Chief Executive will excise the bugs from Guangdong's system. The future of Guangdong depends on it.
strings.GNG_bugfixing_tt: Mistakes and inefficiencies can be corrected. Malignancy, however, must be excised...
strings.GNG_the_scum_of_guangdong_desc:
Organized crime has been a persistent issue in Guangdong ever since its establishment. Both the Yakuza and the Triads not only disturb the social order but jeopardize Guangdong's future through their general shortsightedness and insubordination. If the Chief Executive is to forge Guangdong's anew, both need to be brought in line.

Though the Triads represent a much greater threat in comparison to the Yakuza, the Chief Executive is content to play both against each other and use the resulting advantage to ensure both know their place under our vision.
strings.GNG_the_scum_of_guangdong_tt: ...though the enemy of my enemy can still be useful.
strings.GNG_a_useful_tool_desc:
The underworld is not something to be feared or eliminated, so long as it serves our purposes - and Yokoi Hideki, the chief patron of the Yakuza in Guangdong, is more than amenable to working with us. The man is all about business - and so long as we ensure his business grows, he will make sure our mission to uplift Guangdong is undisturbed.

A man of Yokoi's reputation - with intelligence experience from the Kenpeitai and an unparalleled network of enforcers in the Yakuza - will be a powerful asset as we shine a light into the underbelly of Guangdong...
strings.GNG_replace_triad_bonus_decisions_with_y: Replaces our bonus £GNG_triads_texticon Triad decisions with bonus £GNG_yakuza_texticon Yakuza decisions.
strings.GNG_an_unfortunate_enemy_desc:
We are not so arrogant as to believe vice can be exterminated. So long as we can ensure that our workers remain productive and our factories and laboratories are efficiently operated, we understand that the people must fulfill their baser desires.

Stanley Ho, however, mixes vice with disorder - and that we cannot abide. His frivolous insistence on subsuming peak efficiency for frivolous pleasures provided by the Triads - and his partnership with the weak-kneed Morita Akio and Li Ka-shing - fosters complacency and abets incompetence. The future we seek to build for Guangdong can ill-afford either, and thus we must have Stanley removed from the equation.
strings.GNG_draft_a_plan_desc:
An operation to take down the Triads is no easy feat - it will require meticulous planning and painstaking coordination to even put a dent in their activities, much less neutralize Stanley Ho and his associates.

We must account for all of our resources, within both the government and our newfound Yakuza allies, and determine how to allocate them for maximum effect. We will only get one shot at this before Morita and Li stymie any further action - so we had best make it count.
strings.GNG_draft_a_plan_tt: We will eradicate the £GNG_triads_texticon Triads hooligans in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong - and we will do so most thoroughly.
strings.GNG_big_ambitions_desc:
Ibuka Masaru is not a man given to compromising on his vision, and he will not compromise on eliminating anyone who stands in his way. To give the Triads any room to breathe is to give them room to become a thorn in our side again later; a partial patch, in this case, would be worse than a comprehensive fix.

There will always be contrarians who argue that we cannot realistically expect the Guangdong Police Force to uproot an entire empire of organized crime. They are wrong, and we will spare no expense and no amount of manpower to prove it.
strings.GNG_big_ambitions_effect_tooltip: We will aim high to take down the £GNG_triads_texticon Triads.
strings.GNG_realistic_expectations_desc:
The Guangdong Police Force is, against our hopes, not adequately manned or trained to eradicate the Triads as an effective force in the underworld. Attempting to do so would significantly weaken our ability to provide everyday security, with no guarantee of ultimate success.

However, there is no need to fully dismantle the Triads. All we require is Stanley Ho's submission, and enough arrests to send the message that the Triads interfere with our work at their own peril. A smaller operation can be just as effective in fulfilling our objectives while remaining achievable. In this one instance, where we do not have the luxury of trying again, we cannot let the perfect become the enemy of the good.
strings.GNG_realistic_expectations_effect_toolti: Expectation management and precision are also virtues.
strings.GNG_we_will_handle_it_desc:
No sane engineer would hand over control over the most sensitive, delicate components of their creation to a third party. There is far too much risk of information leaks and of unauthorized modifications that spoil the end product.

The same applies for our plan to dismantle the Triads and capture Stanley Ho. We will keep the Guangdong Police firmly in the driver's seat for the operation, and where they fall short, we will lean on Fujitsu to provide computer-assisted analysis to identify key targets of interest. Our Yakuza 'partners' will be kept to strictly auxiliary roles.
strings.GNG_we_will_handle_it_effect_tooltip: The £GNG_police_texticon Police shall strike with surgical precision.
strings.GNG_synergistic_delegation_desc:
Why should we not use all the tools at our disposal? The Yakuza provide valuable muscle, intelligence, and special 'expertise' needed to beat the Triads at their own game - it would be foolish in the extreme to proceed without their close and willing cooperation. It takes a thief to catch a thief, or so they say.

Where our computer-assisted analysis finds intelligence that our police can't decipher or utilize, we will turn to our associates in the Yakuza to bring their own assets to bear, giving them some discretion to run their competition out of town. They can keep the spoils - as a token of their new relationship with the Chief Executive.
strings.GNG_synergistic_delegation_effect_toolti: To achieve big goals we need the £GNG_yakuza_texticon Yakuza as resources.
strings.GNG_ibuka_shock_and_awe_desc:
We can't send a message to the Triads by focusing on small fry, rolling up their crime networks from the bottom up in quiet arrests. The only message these thugs will understand is one of overwhelming force - a hammer blow of high-profile raids and asset seizures that will leave them dazed and supine before us.

We will start from the top, and work our way down. The Triads will learn to fear us, and the wrath of Chief Executive Ibuka.
strings.GNG_keep_it_quiet_desc:
What good will it do to crack down on the ringleaders, without securing the vital evidence and foot soldiers that expose the true depth of their malignant activity? As tempting as it may be to come down hard on Stanley Ho and his associates, a wave of public arrests would simply drive the Triad organization underground, waiting to resume operations.

We will approach this problem like we would any other - methodically, mechanically, and without mercy. Each and every avenue of escape shall be sealed off in the dark, a precise set of seemingly 'random' actions converging at the final act. When Stanley Ho tries to flee, he will find that we were two steps ahead the entire time.
strings.GNG_keep_it_quiet_effect_tooltip: Slow and steady wins the race.
strings.GNG_the_job_desc:
The men have their orders; the traps are ready to be sprung. The Guangdong Police and the Yakuza - aided by our intelligence analysts, parsing phone records with the help of Fujitsu mainframes - are closing in on Stanley Ho and his petty kingdom of sin.

He will, no doubt, attempt to salvage whatever he can, or failing that, go to ground with the assistance of his Triad associates - or Morita, should it come to that. It matters not; there was never enough room in Guangdong for three kingpins, and Chief Executive Ibuka and Yokoi Hideki have decided that Stanley Ho is the weakest link.

All that remains is to roll the dice...
strings.GNG_the_job_trigger: The £GNG_police_texticon Police are not being reformed
strings.GNG_the_job_prior_focuses_tooltip: The results of the raid on the £GNG_triads_texticon Triads depends on chosen focuses.
strings.GNG_fix_the_plumbing_desc: It is no fiction that governance and the daily life of Guangdong are the beating heart of its security and integrity. It is also no fiction that there are a myriad of issues that have gone rampant under previous administrations' incompetence. Corruption, ineptitude, and massive inefficiency plague this system. Now, it is up to Chief Executive Ibuka to solve these issues by any means necessary, with precision and logic behind him. Under Ibuka's supervision, these ills will be cured and purged, paving the way for a perfection of the system.
strings.GNG_fix_the_plumbing_tt: ...and we must do away with all waste and inefficiency in our security forces.
strings.GNG_at_the_top_desc:
Corruption is an unseeable, but powerful force that consumes the government and bureaucracy of this nation. Everywhere it invades, it creates chaos and disorder within our institutions, which cripples our mission to bring Guangdong to the forefront of modernity.

Complacency, equally as powerful, is created by corruption and blinds many to the vision Ibuka has for Guangdong. This, all of this, must go! At Chief Executive Ibuka's word, we will begin to clamp down on these twin evils, as another step in his path.
strings.GNG_at_the_top_tt: A good example must be set by £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Fujitsu...
strings.GNG_follow_the_paper_desc:
The beauty of bureaucracy is in the tiny details - with every anomalous budget request or inventory change likely to be documented in triplicate. This works to our advantage, for few are clever enough to mask the paper trail entirely - and when done poorly, the alteration of records can become damning evidence in and of itself.

Cleaning out the government and our bureaucracy of the rot that infests it is as simple as following the mistakes, errors, and omissions in our records. Every one of them has a responsible owner, and they will wilt under the light of Fujitsu' superior investigative skills.
strings.GNG_the_right_people_in_the_right_places:
As much as we might be tempted to uproot the entire structure of Guangdong's corrupt bureaucracy to start anew, we neither have the resources nor the time to waste on such an all-encompassing and disruptive endeavor. Thankfully, we don't need to - if a fish rots from the head down, then the first step to rectifying this is to replace the head, retiring known corrupt officials with loyalists from Fujitsu headquarters.

Even if we cannot excise the cancer of corruption overnight, we can ensure that under our direction, the government will no longer take part in it - renewing Guangdong's institutions from the top down.
strings.GNG_the_guangdong_anti_corruption_ordina:
It isn't enough to root out corruption within the civil service. They are simply the tools of corruption, pawns in someone else's designs and machinations. Their loyalties are bought; the crucial question is who the buyer is.

The companies and their stooges in the Legislative Council fancy themselves the true masters of the state, using their wealth to advance their interests. We know this better than anyone else. To stop corruption, we must surveil those corrupting the government at any and all times - and if we can keep an eye on our enemies in the process, so be it. We will command the Legislative Council's respect, or their fear - but they will not subvert our will any longer.
strings.GNG_ears_everywhere_desc:
A great victory has been accomplished as Guangdong's government, which has long been undermined by the influence of our inferior rivals, has been forcefully brought to heel. It was imperative that every vital institution was secured from the constant threat of impotence. Now that our officials have made their presence known this threat has been crushed, much to the betterment of Guangdong. The old filth has ceased and a government fit for the future will rise.

There is nowhere our opponents can not be heard. We are listening.
strings.GNG_on_the_streets_desc:
Domestic security has suffered tremendously under the past period of misgovernment, it seemed no one before Ibuka was willing or, more likely, capable of reorganizing and reinvigorating Guangdong's depleted police force. Security services have to be redeveloped on a fundamental level, bringing them inline with reality so that it is better prepared to strike at rising criminal activity.

The Chief Executive's ideas will be put into practice and safety will be imposed back on to the streets.
strings.GNG_on_the_streets_tt: ...and we will make sure the people below us follow £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Fujitsu's example.
strings.GNG_statistics_do_not_lie_desc:
Data, extensive and candid guidelines for every single action and decision made by the administration; numbers and paragraphs that should be interpreted and treated as gospel, comprehensive instructions which should be followed regardless of the matter.

Why should we treat the matter of criminal activity as an exception? The contemptible lawbreakers and delinquents must be attacked with maximum brutality using the voluminous accumulation of statistics we have gathered on crime since our entry into Guangdong. The police will be directed to perform increased patrols and searches upon the inhabitants of areas or sectors unequivocally proven to be hotbeds of illicit activity from detailed records of past events. It is likely that certain portions of the population will be dissatisfied with our new efforts of security, however, that is simply not of our concern, for we will not neglect known issues due to the grievances of ignorant fools. The data presents the truth, therefore we act upon it, there are no nuances or external variables.
strings.GNG_microsecondmen_desc:
In order to address the crippling shortage of manpower available to the police, a drive will be made to incentivise all citizens with enough competence and qualification to join a new militia. Only the best will be accepted, for it is only the best that can bring stability to Guangdong, they will then receive intensive training and equipment - which will only be matched by the police themselves.

The dire situation demands quality; we will provide it.
strings.GNG_the_guangdong_modern_police_ordinanc: The police, in its current form, is a glaring outdated symbol of the obsolescent past. The equipment that they wield and the jurisdiction they possess are antiquated and minimal, an evident contrast to the advancements we have brought upon this nation. We will do away with the antediluvian tools of enforcement currently in use, replacing them with innovative and modern weapons and state-of-the-art computing equipment designed by our talented employees at Fujitsu; this will fully ensure the state is secure against threats to the maintained order and that our administration of visionaries will continue to thrive. We will increase the currently limited jurisdiction given to the police force, allowing them to perform their duties with optimized efficiency and avoid the useless mountains of red tape. Ibuka and Fujitsu have brought the future to Guangdong, it is time we bring the police and our nation's safety up to speed.
We have assigned an amendment to the Ordinance.
strings.GNG_eyes_everywhere_desc: The populace and citizenry of Guangdong are deceitful and duplicitous, their tenements and gathering spots are where dissent and disorder have their genesis. We will increase our efforts of surveillance across the streets of the Three Pearls, placing every person under the omnipresent supervision of the state. By implementing such measures, we will coerce the inhabitants of Guangdong into submission, discouraging them from becoming obstacles of progress and keeping them in line and out of the way. The officers within our vigilant police force will be instructed to increase the intensity and scale of their patrols, to thoroughly and extensively inspect every crevice and alleyway, as to ensure all traces of criminal activity be exterminated. The residents of Guangdong will learn to abide by the law, for it will be known that there is no leniency for criminal activity and setting us back.
strings.GNG_the_panopticon_desc: Under the guidance and watch of Ibuka, Guangdong has been utterly transformed; from an immobile, antiquated and inefficient disappointment to a prestigious paradigm of prosperity and progress. The forceful yet necessary hand of security and order has successfully coerced and put every man, woman, and child in Guangdong into the vision and path Ibuka has outlined for them, prevailing against the decrepit forces of chaos and disorder. Newfound harmony and concord have befallen the streets of the Three Pearls, no matter which position you possess or occupation you specialize in, every person now operates as intended, for the benefit and innovation of the nation. Adherence to Ibuka's vision has brought the populace of Guangdong into a new era of joy and prosperity, may they revel in the freedom and release we have granted them.
strings.GNG_a_well_ordered_society_desc:
We have thoroughly and extensively cleansed the formerly vexatious society of Guangdong of its internal corruptions; we have subjugated a rabid beast once thought to be untamable. Ibuka, the man that embodies vision and drive, has united Guangdong under the triumphant banner of progress, concord, and merit.

The once unruly and obstreperous underworld has been pacified, their illicit activities and backdoor deals no longer plague us. The pestiferous worms of ineptitude and corruption no longer writhe within the ripe fruit of government, having been rooted out by our efforts. Our citizens, now obedient to the law and grateful for our gifts, thrive off of the lucrative opportunities we have granted them. Our security forces now adequately fulfill the standards of modernity, a newly invigorated institution that will ensure no obstacles exist to the united vision. The cogs of the well-oiled machine continue to rotate, carrying Guangdong into a future of harmony, uninterrupted by the forces of dissent and inefficiency; Ibuka has achieved part of his vision, for Guangdong now stands firm and adamant, ready for the endeavors the future will bring.
strings.GNG_a_well_ordered_society_tt: Everything has its place, everyone has their role - exactly as £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Fujitsu assigns.
strings.GNG_the_engineers_paradise_desc:
So how does one define victory, after all? Going by the strictest definition victory is but the defeat of those who dare to stand in our way, and this we certainly have accomplished. What more fitting a testimony to our victory is there, then, than the countless halfwits and bleeding hearts we triumphed over, now left wallowing and seething without a place under our vision?

But to those of us who have dedicated our minds and hearts all those years to this Jewel of the South, victory means more - so much more. Victory is one technological marvel after another lining up the shelves and storefronts; victory is the row after row of chrome-clad skyscrapers sprouting across the horizon, every one of them an engine of progress, a pillar of the future; victory is the long-awaited tranquility finally descending upon our streets, punctuated only by the clatters of factory gears and the vigilant beeps of Fujitsu automatons; but above all else, victory is knowing that no matter how many wrangles and struggles we went through along the way, we, under the guidance of Chief Executive Ibuka, stayed true to our one and only purpose - to innovate, and to illuminate this savage earth with our brilliance.

Victory is a dream realized, as Guangdong casts its blazing light upon this magnificent blue marble we all stand on, for ever and ever.
strings.GNG_the_engineers_paradise_tt: Greatness is not measured by men's achievements... but by their ambition.
strings.GNG_the_future_belongs_to_pearls: The Future Belongs to the Pearls
strings.GNG_shelter_the_vanguards_of_the_future: Shelter the Vanguards of the Future
strings.GNG_Ibuka_Persistence_Point_tt: Nothing shall tamper with Ibuka's vision of £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong.
strings.GNG_Ibuka_Reconciliation_Point_tt: Compromise can go a long way, as much as it pains Ibuka.
strings.GNG_the_spanner_in_the_works_desc:
The cosmos has a way with toying with people.

Just when the gears have finally clicked into place, disaster strikes. Just when the future has finally strode within our reach, it is seemingly ripped from our hands once more - this time by neither Morita nor Matsushita, but by imbecilic people and equally imbecilic squabbles half a globe away. Where three continents converge the conflagration of war ravages everything in sight; as oil fields burn and global commerce evaporates, Guangdong, like the rest of the planet, is caught in the heat.

This rise in the thermostat, however, will only be fleeting, as will be all the “panic” and “dread” that's bound to follow. We ask you, citizens of Guangdong: what is there to fear? Aren't unforeseen calamities precisely what Guangdong's model - of excellence, competitiveness and adaptability - has accounted for? There is nothing to fear; nothing at all! With diligence in our hearts and just the right amount of fine-tuning our policies we shall rise to the challenge, emerge stronger and brighter, and show our skeptics both home and abroad just what we, vanguards of the future, are made of!
strings.GNG_the_spanner_in_the_works_tt: As £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong convulses, Ibuka races to cure what ails his £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong...
strings.GNG_blow_the_fuse_desc: Recent difficulties in the global market have resulted in a marked increase in production cost. In order to remain competitive, it will be necessary to cut superfluous areas of expenditure. Workers will be expected to take a pay cut, and many businessmen will not receive the generous subsidies they have grown accustomed to. Until the storm clears, we must all make sacrifices.
strings.GNG_our_chance_is_now_desc: We have Guangdong's ear. The people buy only Fujitsu, just as we have instructed them to do so. While lesser competitors panic and dissolve around us, Fujitsu's innovativeness has carried us through. The time is now for Fujitsu to reach new heights, and we must now begin the climb.
strings.GNG_our_test_has_come_desc: A once in a lifetime economic crash does make a population susceptible to panic, but two in little less than a decade? Predictably, hysteria has claimed our nation, but the harbingers of stability are finally at hand. A reminder for the Guangdonese is in order. The people must be reminded that this obstacle is little more than just one more test, and Fujitsu's foresight shall see us through it, like it always has.
strings.GNG_the_future_belongs_to_fujitsu_desc: Fujitsu's supremacy is unquestionable, but only to those bright enough to see it. Our guidance has allowed the Oil Crisis to blow over easily enough, but there are some non Fujitsu bureaucrats and companies that are at risk of foiling our well crafted plans. To eliminate them, we must first grease some wheels and make concrete our influence over these institutions.
strings.GNG_the_future_belongs_to_fujitsu_passed: Because we passed the £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Guangdong Trademark Ordinance, we get following effects:
strings.GNG_the_future_belongs_to_fujitsu_not_pa: Because we did not pass the £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Guangdong Trademark Ordinance, we get following effects:
strings.GNG_the_future_belongs_to_pearls_desc: Far gone are the days when Guangdong's economy relied on inconsequential trinkets - rice, silk, raw material. The path to prosperity is one that leaves an everlasting impact; therefore, in the state's great urban centres, to which the countryside serves an auxiliary role in good times and proves an unwelcome distraction in bad times. As we are currently withstanding the latter, it would be prudent to redirect state resources from rural areas to where they are most sorely needed.
strings.GNG_and_the_man_to_fix_it_desc:
By now all our contingency measures have been employed to full effect, but it would appear that the aftershock of the Oil Crisis runs... deeper than anticipated. Oil supply remains frustratingly inadequate, prices for industrial and civilian goods soar while the power of the wallet plummets, and petty whines and grumbles ferment once more within the exposed woodworks of our society.

Chief Executive Ibuka, of course, knows better. With unmatched intellect and unwavering dedication he has led us all through one insurmountable obstacle after another in our quest for the future, and why should today's “crisis” be any exception? We have our work cut out for us, and with an extra bit of executive power consolidation Ibuka shall once again take the lead and face the challenges head on, as he has always done for our sake. Before you raise your doubts, citizens of Guangdong, ask yourselves: where would you be without him?
strings.GNG_and_the_man_to_fix_it_tt: More must be done to stop the Oil Crisis from derailing Ibuka's £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong - much more.
strings.GNG_restore_the_power_desc: Despite our best efforts, Guangdong's economy remains victim to all manner of parasites. While they have certainly exacerbated our recent troubles, the global slump has left them more exposed than ever before. It would be a shame to let any good crisis go to waste, so swift and immediate action shall be taken in order to permanently remove some of our most persistent barriers to economic success.
strings.GNG_restore_the_power_tt: The spark of innovation must be lit anew - one way or the other.
strings.GNG_to_those_who_fight_desc: Fujitsu has always held the belief that one's best efforts ought to be rewarded, and therefore the opposite also holds true. An enterprise which stands incapable of weathering the current slump is one which was doomed from birth by its own incompetence. Our government has limited resources, better allocated elsewhere than the sisyphean task of propping up the failed experiments of others.
strings.GNG_to_those_who_fight_tt: In Ibuka's £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong, the future is not given - it is won.
strings.GNG_comes_survival_desc:
The circumstances behind the global economic downturn are a once-in-a-lifetime occurrence, and it is understandable, if disappointing, that otherwise successful firms failed to adequately prepare. In light of this, the government will subsidize struggling businesses with an otherwise reliable track record.

This must not be taken as blind generosity, but as highly-specific assistance for a highly-specific issue.
strings.GNG_comes_survival_tt: We know who deserves to be saved - and saved they shall be.
strings.GNG_were_in_this_together_desc: The current situation affects all of us, from the highest executive to the lowest factory employee. Naturally, a problem which burdens all of society requires a significant contribution from all of its able members. Our citizens will be made to understand the need to contribute more and do with less, though they are not required to like it.
strings.GNG_our_model_reigns_supreme_desc: Our government was founded on the strength of its economic model, and the current crisis is merely its ultimate test. Were it to require assistance now, we would merely delegitimize ourselves in front of Tokyo, proving ourselves inferior to the decrepit bloat of the Zaibatsu. We must stand on our own two feet if we are to achieve true greatness.
strings.GNG_our_model_reigns_supreme_tt: The Oil Crisis is but a temporary setback to our Chief Executive's limitless ambition - and everyone will understand this.
strings.GNG_our_camaraderie_lasts_forever_desc: Guangdong and Fujitsu have long provided cutting-edge solutions to the Sphere's technical issues, and at bargain prices. Should our erstwhile allies wish to continue receiving the benefits of our partnership, it would be in their best interests to aid our continued smooth operation. While naturally our model is perfectly capable of self-sufficiency, it is in the interests of all that the Sphere's finances flow to where they will be best put to use.
strings.GNG_our_camaraderie_lasts_forever_tt: To know when to accept help is not a sign of weakness. Being too stubborn, however, is.
strings.GNG_shelter_the_vanguards_of_the_future_:
Fujitsu has always prided itself at being at the forefront of everything it tries - that no matter what the challenge or the discipline, Fujitsu engineers and scientists will master it to the fullest extent possible, and then some. It is this visionary attitude that has informed every one of Ibuka's actions since becoming Chief Executive, setting an example for all who would follow him.

These individuals - the vanguard of Guangdong, and Fujitsu's, future - must not be tossed aside like a defective silicon wafer or circuit board. Their wages shall be paid, their work will be funded and subsidized, and in return they shall give us their unwavering loyalty and excellence.
£GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Fujitsu shall lead the way into the future - by any means necessary.
strings.GNG_stack_up_our_warehouses_desc:
Even in the difficult times of the Oil Crisis, Fujitsu products are so good they practically sell themselves. While our competitors find themselves struggling to sell premium rice cookers and televisions in an age of austerity, businesses will always be looking for that computational edge that only Fujitsu can provide.

We can position ourselves to meet that demand, at price, and in the quantities that our customers demand. Even if it means that we put some quality and updates to the side, the Oil Crisis is an unprecedented opportunity for us to seize the market share we've always dreamed of, which will surely get better once the economy starts to grow again.
strings.GNG_stack_up_our_warehouses_tt: As long as there's demand, there will have to be supply. It's how every other manufacturer operates, let alone us.
strings.GNG_perfect_our_assembly_lines_desc:
Fujitsu is a byword for quality and perfection across the Sphere, and this will not change even in the most turbulent of times. While the competition struggles to economize and adapt to new times, we will stride firmly towards the future.

The optimization of production processes, the streamlining of our assembly lines, and the revamping of our product design will result in a leaner and meaner Fujitsu machine, with a razor-sharp focus on the bleeding edge of technological development. We do not need a mountain of products diluting our brand - all we need is a selection of the best.
strings.GNG_perfect_our_assembly_lines_tt: If we let external crises deter us from maintaining technical perfection as ever we'd be no better than those second-rate producers.
strings.GNG_no_connection_shall_go_unused_desc:
Even if Fujitsu remains steadfast in the face of the Oil Crisis and the ongoing recession, the same cannot be said of our many Japanese suppliers and customers - many of which are looking to the Chief Executive for guidance. The stakes could not be higher - if all of them were to fail, we would risk treading the road that led to the late Chief Executive Suzuki's downfall, leaving Fujitsu exposed and bereft of support at a crucial time.

We will meet Fujitsu's need for less critical components or materials from the web of Japanese suppliers already operating in Guangdong. Any business needs customers, after all, and meeting their needs halfway will surely lead to greater dividends down the road - when things improve. As they must.
strings.GNG_no_connection_shall_go_unused_tt: To insist on £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Fujitsu going it alone would stretch our resources to the breaking point, at a time of great uncertainty. We need not go it alone...
strings.GNG_no_resource_shall_go_untapped_desc:
The pursuit of perfection is an uncompromising one, even as the economy continues to decelerate. There is simply no excuse to waste effort, resources, or labor - especially given all of our effort setting up our independent supply lines from the Steel Belt.

We will reiterate - by all means available to us - that we expect peak performance from every worker involved in feeding the industrial heart of Guangdong. If one can walk, one can work - and as in the previous crisis, there is no shortage of willing hands looking for a job. Fujitsu will have its due, come what may.
strings.GNG_no_resource_shall_go_untapped_tt: Our products, our methods - and our labor. We shall ensure nothing is wasted, and used to its full potential.
strings.GNG_no_resource_shall_go_untapped_passed: Because we passed the £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Guangdong Organized Labor Ordinance, we get following effects:
strings.GNG_no_resource_shall_go_untapped_not_pa: Because we did not pass the £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Guangdong Organized Labor Ordinance, we get following effects:
strings.GNG_weld_the_circuitry_desc: In battles of old, most casualties occurred during a rout, where retreating armies became impaled on the spears of their pursuers. This has been perhaps too easy for our citizens to remember in this land of cutting-edge technology. The panic generated by an economic downturn has the potential to be much more harmful than the immediate financial consequences. As such, we must put the full force of our connections and devices towards ensuring calm at all costs.
strings.GNG_weld_the_circuitry_tt: Every defect - every imperfection - must be soldered together anew.
strings.GNG_open_the_digital_eye_desc: Where friendly encouragement fails, proactive measures must be taken. It is not enough to simply assume that our citizens will all see reason. To prevent wide scale disruption, we will have to quickly move against sources of disruption. To do this, we must be able to watch keenly for disruption all across Guangdong. Once again, Fujitsu has a solution ready and raring to go.
strings.GNG_open_the_digital_eye_passed: Because we passed the £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Guangdong Zoning Ordinance, we get following effects:
strings.GNG_open_the_digital_eye_not_passed: Because we did not pass the £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Guangdong Zoning Ordinance, we get following effects:
strings.GNG_discard_the_rust_desc: The time for charity has passed. Our industry has matured rapidly, far too rapidly for certain elements of the laboring population to keep up with. We can no longer make allowances for aging, illiterate peasant halfwits to stall production and take up valuable factory space. Our employees will be vetted extensively to ensure their education and skill set are adequate, and the waste shall be done away with.
strings.GNG_discard_the_rust_tt: The brightest must survive to shine a path into the future. The rest - don't ask about the rest.
strings.GNG_discard_the_rust_passed: Because we passed the £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Guangdong Education Ordinance, we get following effects:
strings.GNG_discard_the_rust_not_passed: Because we did not pass the £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Guangdong Education Ordinance, we get following effects:
strings.GNG_equal_opportunities_desc: Guangdong remains haunted by certain inefficiencies from its former days as an agrarian backwater. Large swathes of our working population have little more than a peasant's education, something which raises inherent contradictions when they are put to use making cutting-edge technology. However, the unenlightened mind can still prove dangerous when it develops a grudge. Blind layoffs are inefficient, but perhaps they will be seen as somehow more fair.
strings.GNG_equal_opportunities_tt: The only way to enforce the austerity we need to survive is by making sure the pain is equally shared - and Ibuka shares just a portion of the blame.
strings.GNG_no_quarter_desc: There's just no reasoning with some people. Despite our extensive measures to resolve the current predicament, all forms of insipid complaints still hound the Government Complex, and opportunistic rabble-rousers shout from the streets. Those who choose to complain rather than contribute will be made an example of. We shall see all, and all shall be made well.
strings.GNG_no_quarter_tt:
We have one message for our detractors: it's not our problem, it's yours.
Deal with it.
strings.GNG_an_invisible_cage_desc:
As dissidents and rabble-rousers once more take to Guangdong's streets in opposition to our so-called “inadequate response,” we must remind ourselves to treat these misguided fools with a velvet glove. Senseless they may be, we cannot risk needless provocation when we can least afford it.

Thankfully, there are measures we can take that are far less disruptive to the parade of agitators filling the streets. Road closures, traffic barriers, and corporate announcements should do their part to smooth some of the edges.
strings.GNG_an_invisible_cage_tt:
We have a message for our detractors: it's not you, it's us.
Now would they kindly step aside?
strings.GNG_our_japanese_compatriots_desc: As much as we may rely on the Zhujin, we rely on the Japanese even more. Japanese investors and officials must be convinced of the wisdom of Ibuka's vision of a modern, efficient Guangdong forged in rivers of silicon, built by expertly trained minds, sold at premium prices and at exorbitant profits to the endless masses. If it takes some incentivizing to convince them, then so be it; Guangdong would be nothing with Japan, and it would disintegrate without the Japanese. The Zhujin will just have to wait their turn.
strings.GNG_our_japanese_compatriots_tt: At times like these, we turn to £GNG_expats_texticon Japanese capital to bury our problems.
strings.GNG_our_zhujin_aides_desc:
Guangdong may have been built by the Japanese, but it is run by the Zhujin, who labor away every day to forge a new brighter future, Ibuka's future. Without them, Guangdong would still be stuck in the past, still behind the simpletons in Manchukuo.

The Zhujin have earned their loyalty; it is time we reward them for it. Promotions and subsidies will do much to alleviate the strain of the crisis, no matter the howls of protests from the Japanese or the endless discontent from the Chinese. For now, it is their turn to wait.
strings.GNG_our_zhujin_aides_tt: In times of crisis, local expertise is irreplaceable.
strings.GNG_money_where_it_should_be_desc:
While our commitments may be up, our spending is not, for we are in no position to squander our fiscal stability amid the Oil Crisis. Murmurs of discontent there may be; they are simply the price we must pay, lest we shatter the promise of the Silicon Dream.
