For the local officials who have too long skated off of bribery and graft, this should hopefully serve as a wake-up call. One should not need to spend a stack of Yen every day to do their duty, and this time of crisis will do well to hammer this into their heads.
strings.GNG_money_where_it_should_be_tt: The government will set an example for the rest of £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong - not a single yen wasted.
strings.GNG_from_the_ground_up_desc:
While our position in the Legislative Council remains secure, many of our fellow compatriots in the legislature remain unable to put the needs of Guangdong over their own ambitions. Complaining daily about our supposed misdeeds, slights, and all manner of transgression, petty or not.

We might have tolerated this behavior in earlier times, but Guangdong is in crisis, and we cannot permit those who are unable to see beyond their own two feet such privileges any longer. They and their corrupt practices and associates will be removed, with force if necessary. No matter the short-term instability, Guangdong will grow stronger for it.
strings.GNG_from_the_ground_up_condition: We passed the £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Guangdong Anti-Corruption Ordinance
strings.GNG_from_the_ground_up_tt:
The profit motive is not one meant for the individual.
£GNG_legco_texticon LegCo will need to relearn this lesson - the hard way.
strings.GNG_once_again_asking_desc:
While our position in the Legislative Council remains secure, many of our fellow compatriots in the legislature continue to put their own ambitions over the needs of Guangdong. Complaining daily about our supposed misdeeds, slights, and all manner of transgression, imagined or not.

Yet, we cannot afford more instability in these trying times, and as much as we hate to admit it, we need their apathy, if not loyalty, to see us through the crisis. Closed-door meetings and backroom deals have gotten us this far. A few more will have to do.
strings.GNG_once_again_asking_tt: Self-preservation is not an instinct limited to £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Fujitsu.
strings.GNG_plug_the_leak_desc:
The one remarkably consistent thing throughout human history, however, is their propensity to flinch and escape at the first sign of trouble. You run into a wall, you turn around, you flee and bail yourself out. You don't bother pushing ahead; anyone that does, you call them fools and lunatics. Such are the lies man has fed to himself, every day, since he was born on this earth.

It is only too predictable, then, that more and more of our labor force, engineers, and Japanese “noblemen” are hurtling towards Guangdong's coastlines and borders even as its prospects have begun to recover from the Oil Crisis. Human cowardice is a real problem, and it is time we finally cooked up real solutions.
strings.GNG_plug_the_leak_tt: The £GNG_chinese_texticon Chinese jumping the border, and the £GNG_expats_texticon Japanese boarding outbound flights..
strings.GNG_no_one_in_no_one_out_desc: Trust in the government has failed. More and more of our citizens cross the northern and western borders. Trusting these fools to remain inside of the state's borders is little more than a pipedream. All borders must be tightened as much as possible, be they land or sea. None shall escape.
strings.GNG_no_time_for_tomfoolery_desc:
It is incomprehensible why our people decide to flee to the poverty-stricken Republic of China, or the infinitely corrupt Empire of Japan. Still, we must at least try to keep these vital refugees within the borders of Guangdong.

While we recover, it would suit us well to spend some of this growth on campaigns designed to convince the refugees and potential refugees to remain home.
strings.GNG_no_time_for_tomfoolery_tt: ...will see the benefits of staying in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong...
strings.GNG_our_loyalest_guardians_desc: Pretty pennies were used to build and reinforce the police force of our wealthy state and their supplementary Fujitsu funded militias. The means are in Ibuka's hands, now he merely must apply them.
strings.GNG_our_loyalest_guardians_tt: ...under the peerless protection of the £GNG_police_texticon Police.
strings.GNG_our_loyalest_guardians_passed: Because we passed the £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Guangdong Modern Police Ordinance with amendment Restrain Kenpeitai, we get following effects:
strings.GNG_our_loyalest_guardians_not_passed: Because we did not pass the £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Guangdong Modern Police Ordinance with amendment Restrain Kenpeitai, we get following effects:
strings.GNG_our_greatest_assets_desc: When the thought of escape enters our citizens' minds, it seems no amount of logic or reason can shake that thinking from their heads. To prevent these treasonous thoughts from ever occurring, we must employ the ever helpful Yakuza and Kenpeitai contingent residing in our state.
strings.GNG_our_greatest_assets_tt: ...and have nothing to fear from our trusted associates.
strings.GNG_our_greatest_assets_passed: Because we passed the £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Guangdong Modern Police Ordinance with amendment Empower Kenpeitai, we get following effects:
strings.GNG_our_greatest_assets_not_passed: Because we did not pass the £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Guangdong Modern Police Ordinance with amendment Empower Kenpeitai, we get following effects:
strings.GNG_our_greatest_assets_yakuza_thrives: Because the £GNG_yakuza_texticon Yakuza thrives, we get the following effects:
strings.GNG_our_greatest_assets_yakuza_displease: Because the £GNG_yakuza_texticon Yakuza are displeased, we get the following effects:
strings.GNG_all_systems_go_desc:
We made it. Through storm and fire, the Jewel of the South prevails; against the smog of uncertainty, Ibuka's vision triumphs. Streets, markets, government halls - the circuit boards of society have sprung back into operation, as Guangdong entrusts itself further to Fujitsu's calculations, expertise, and rightful guidance.

But our work doesn't stop - and how could it ever? How should we succumb to feebleness and complacency, when there remain so many technological wonders left for us to create, so many truths left for us to unearth in this boundless universe? Citizens of Guangdong, we know the answer all too well: never! The gears of progress will churn on, and Guangdong shall stand, tall and proud as it has always been, as the sole beacon of excellence upon this ungrateful and savage earth no matter what it hurls in our faces!

All hail Chief Executive Ibuka, all hail truth, and may the great everlasting enlightenment be with us for centuries more!
strings.GNG_all_systems_go_tt: We have remade £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong in the crucible of crisis. Now we flip the switch, and step into the future.
strings.GNG_they_bark_they_bite_they_whine: They Bark, They Bite, They Whine
strings.GNG_its_their_fault_it_always_is: It's Their Fault, It Always Is
strings.GNG_upon_pillars_of_salt_pillars_of_sand: Pillars of Salt, Pillars of Sand
strings.GNG_not_even_in_the_face_of_armageddon: Not Even In The Face of Armageddon
strings.GNG_error_desc:
We thought it'd be enough - the labs, the billboards, the blazing citadels of technological brilliance towering over Kōshū, Honkon, and Makao. We thought we'd had it hammered into every one of our citizens' skulls and made them see it all: the resilience, strength, and objective superiority of our vision. Because it all worked, didn't it? It worked, despite the constant whines, grumbles, naysaying from every direction. It worked, even in the face of seemingly insurmountable global catastrophe.

Turns out it isn't enough. It never was.

Two entire networks of organized resistance, bubbling up from beneath our collapsing streets and government halls; two entire cesspits filled to the brim with thankless imbeciles, converging into a tsunami of filth spreading regression and savagery wherever it goes. They clamor for change, for action, despite all the change and action that Fujitsu has done for their sakes; they clamor for a “better future”, gleefully spitting on the very future that we've practically stuffed into their hands.

Day after day, minute after minute, second after grating second Guangdong lies paralyzed, despondent, as eternal enlightenment slips further and further from her reach; but we will not falter. Our vision remains valid and unwavering as ever, whatever those cretins do. It works. It always will. It has to.
strings.GNG_error_tt:
What we did not expect, what we did not account for - what should not be happening.
And yet, it is.
strings.GNG_diagnosis_desc: We did not invest so heavily into surveillance for nothing, did we? The electric eye's hour has come, and with it, we shall find out exactly who, what and where is accounting for all this disruption. They shall be found, isolated and removed, and things will go back to their intended order. Our society cannot, and will not, be ground to a halt by such barbarous acts.
strings.GNG_diagnosis_tt:
Identify, isolate, and excise - such is how aberrations are treated.
New £decision_icon_small decisions to reduce £GNG_riot_strength_texticon riot strength are unlocked.
strings.GNG_the_heart_of_our_state_desc:
We have not spent so much time, money, and effort bending the Legislative Council to our will for them to go silent in a moment of crisis. They represent Fujitsu's interests and policies to the larger populace of Guangdong, the emissaries of our promises of Guangdong will become.

If the Chinese and the Zhujin insist on clinging to memories of the past and obsolete concepts of life, then our messaging has clearly fallen short. The Legislative Council must redouble their efforts to propagate our message to the masses, and we will make clear what happens to those who shirk from their duties - for they have no place in the future we envision.
strings.GNG_the_brain_of_our_nation_desc:
Fujitsu has overcome every problem set out before it with the same tools: tried and tested human innovation and ingenuity, boundless when unleashed. These civil disturbances are just another challenge, another requirement to be resolved in pursuit of our eventual objectives.

Only Fujitsu sees the future, and we shall see it come to fruition, no matter the cost.
strings.GNG_guangdongs_vessels_desc: While the rioters deserve nothing less than the stick, it is regrettably necessary to provide the rest of Guangdong's indolent masses with a carrot. Once more, they shall be reminded of the boons Fujitsu has brought to their standard of living, the economy, and human progress. Fujitsu is beneficial. Fujitsu is necessary. There is no alternative. They will be made to understand, no matter how many times we must repeat ourselves. Remain calm. Remain calm. Remain calm.
strings.GNG_and_what_about_our_ears_desc:
We continue to rely on the Police, the Kenpeitai, and Fujitsu militias to serve as the enforcers of our vision of Guangdong's future, even as the tribulations of the Oil Crisis have worn on their nerves and thinned their numbers.

Now, more than ever, those loyal to us must be made aware of the cost of failure! Reactionaries and sentimentalists alike bear down on the gate of progress, and they are first in the firing line. Their choice has been made for them; we only have to remind them of that.
strings.GNG_and_our_eyes_desc:
Immense sums have been spent to enmesh Guangdong in a web of cables and surveillance tape, shining light into the darkest crevasses of our cities and townships. None of this investment will be of any use if it goes unmanned in a time where we need every shred of visibility we can get.

We will mandate members of our security forces, Fujitsu engineers, and our executives to man the surveillance systems at all hours. Not a single suspect movement must escape their notice! We can excuse laziness in normal times - but in times like these, there can be no excuse for tardiness.
strings.GNG_paradise_lost_desc:
Despite our best efforts, it simply will not end. The streets remain in the grip of radicalism and chaos. Tokyo and Nanjing circle like wolves around our exposed throats. All that has been built stands on the verge of being swept away. And the people seem to be happy with that prospect.

Why are they doing this? Have we... have I created something terrible?
strings.GNG_paradise_lost_tt:
Surely, things aren't so bad as to require extreme action...
New £decision_icon_small decisions to reduce £GNG_riot_strength_texticon riot strength and £GNG_riot_radicalism_texticon radicalism are unlocked.
strings.GNG_they_bark_they_bite_they_whine_desc:
It's no wonder these insects are trying to tear down what I have created. They barely have any cohesion amongst themselves, so how could they possibly understand anything greater than their own base impulses? That's fine. I can work with that.

Throw some meat into the pit, and the bastards will rip each other to shreds for the tiniest morsel. You want a better life, do you? Fucking work for it then. Give me the names and places I need, and you'll get your scraps. Let's see how much of a fight the rest can put up while looking over their shoulder constantly.
strings.GNG_reach_out_desc:
Imbeciles, insects, mediocrities, parasites, so you keep calling them. You're so above them, your visions are grander than anything they could ever achieve. Didn't stop them from getting one over you this time though, did it? Turns out people aren't dolls in your toybox, and they won't be played with and disposed of to suit your whims.

If you want them to step down, you're going to have to try something other than condescension for a change. You're going to have to pay attention to the concerns of others for once. Don't like it? Tough.
strings.GNG_make_amends_desc:
Yes, yes, they don't have your vision and your drive. They just aren't as brilliant as you, right? It's good you're capable of singlehandedly managing every part of government and business administration, then. After all, that's what you'd have to be in order to manage a state as riven by ethnic and class divides as the one you preside over.

Your fellow Japanese are just as backed into a corner as you, and should be your natural allies, but they aren't looking to you for leadership. They see you as an overbearing liability, and unless you change your tune, they may just hand you to the mob personally. Maybe you'd deserve it, too.
strings.GNG_its_their_fault_it_always_is_desc:
I should've known. I should've seen it coming a mile away. It's never just Akio and his degenerates or Matsushita and his sycophants - no, the stench of idiocy and treachery goes on forever and ever, from the Legislative Council complex all the way to the average boardroom. “Japanese communities”, more like Japanese pig-dens.

But no matter. The rot runs deep, but Fujitsu's tentacles run deeper. If none of these people give a flying damn about Guangdong's future, then I don't see why I should care about theirs; all their “livelihood”, all their “job security” can go into the trash can for all I care. “B-but Mister Chief Executive, what about my mountains of paychecks and hoarded goodies?” Easy. How about you stop staining this earth with your fucking filth?
strings.GNG_upon_pillars_of_salt_pillars_of_sand:
Oh, so now the Chinese decide to try something with any semblance of ambition, and of course, it's burning down their own homes in a temper tantrum. Time and time again, I ask myself why they can't all be like that Lee Hei kid, or even the Zhujin.

How the hell did these people manage to dominate East Asia for two millennia? From all I've seen, despite all I've done, the Chinese want nothing more than to live like cavemen. Fine. I'll give you what you want. Time to send the CCL back to the fucking Stone Age.
strings.GNG_concede_desc:
What did you expect? The Chinese have been living resentfully under Japan's bootheel for decades now, and your tenure has done nothing but press it in further. Appeals to humanity won't work on someone like you, who sees people as little more than machines. Which makes it a damn good thing your hallowed vision doesn't even apply to basic principles of engineering.

Tell me, do fuses and resistors hold back the grand ambitions of a circuit? Is it structurally wise to send the maximum amount of voltage possible coursing through the wires at any given moment? No? Well done, genius. If you do that, the machine will break, likely harming anyone near it. You want to keep your job, or even the remnants of your fragile ego? Ease off the Chinese, before you cause a critical overload.
strings.GNG_fleas_maggots_parasites_desc:
By the Emperor and his divine ancestors, what do those Zhujin even want any more? Haven't those idiots, those traitors and ingrates, managed to forge new identities for themselves under my rule? Are they not satisfied with everything I've given to them?! No? They don't want me? Then I don't want them! They can fucking GO TO HELL, the sons of swine!

... There's only one way of going about it. The very concept of letting Chinese barbarians into our Guangdong society - no, my Guangdong society - was a goddamn mistake. I'll beat the GFT into the ground and show no mercy. It's the only means I've got to fix this cock-up.
strings.GNG_ask_yourself_desc:
Stop, damn you to hell! Stop!
You thrice-damned idiot! You accursed ingrate! To stab people that are just like you once were in the back! What? 'That isn't what I'm doing'? Bullshit!
Think, Gods and Emperor damn you, think! Aren't the Zhujin like you? Didn't you start out with nothing at the beginning, until you hit a big break with that telecom company? Didn't you work your way up, forge yourself a new identity? So then aren't you beating them down for being like you, you traitor?

...

'Yes, they are, and yes, I am'? Good, at least you realize it. Now realize this too, you ruthless German-aping fucking good-for-nothing: if you turn your back on them, you're turning your back on yourself!
strings.GNG_hubris_nemesis_catharsis_desc:
I never asked for any of this. Did I channel all my days, all my vigor, all my decades of accumulated expertise into building this shining bastion of reason by the South China Sea just for it to be razed to the ground before my eyes? Did I offer a helping hand to those rabid dogs just for them to sink their ungrateful fangs into? No. Of course not. None of it was supposed to end this way, but it did. In spite of - no, because of - everything I'd done.

Where did I go wrong? Just what would it take to silence all those screams and shouts and fire crackles, to hammer it into their rotting brains that Guangdong is dying all thanks to them? Just what would it take for them to fucking get it? No, there must be an answer lying somewhere. There has to.

Please, someone tell me...
strings.GNG_hubris_nemesis_catharsis_completeted: One click, and a heart opens up.
strings.GNG_hubris_nemesis_catharsis_tt: How did we - I - get here?
strings.GNG_ibuka_riots_focus_var_2_tt: We can continue fixing £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong from its core.
strings.GNG_rapture_desc:
Four months, five months, six... quite frankly, I've lost count altogether on how long it's been going on. It seems those morons have lost count, too, seeing how they're perfectly fine with keeping things the way they are. Sounds good to me.

The time for tolerance is over. Starting today, all forms of dissent, unrest, and treachery are to be liquidated on sight. They don't deserve my future. They don't deserve a single goddamned thing.

Forgive me, Guangdong, for I have failed you.
strings.GNG_rapture_available_tt: Ibuka has the willpower to implement his vision, no matter what it might cost.
strings.GNG_rapture_tt:
Enough.
No more compromises. No more half-measures. No more vacillating.
£GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong will be exactly as I will it.
New £decision_icon_small decisions to drastically reduce £GNG_riot_strength_texticon riot strength are unlocked.
strings.GNG_rapture_no_negotiation_tt: Chief Executive Ibuka will decree no negotation with the £GNG_rioters_texticon Rioters.
strings.GNG_admit_it_desc:
Four months, five months, six... the shitstorm just keeps going and going and yet here you sit, still so blissfully oblivious as to how to clean up after your own mess. Ever wonder why?

Because no man is an island, and every man is a piece of the continent. Because no one else's moronic enough like you, dear genius, to make an enemy of literally every other person on the planet all by himself. Here you go. Here's the skeleton key to all your woes, the ultimate solution you've craved so badly. Happy? Now go on, try and put it into practice like the man of the sciences you are. You know what to do.

Let go. Reach out. Bow. Say it out loud to their faces that yes, all you've done is trample on them and yes, they all deserve so much better than this.

And beg that Guangdong forgives you, for you've already failed her long ago.
strings.GNG_admit_it_available_tt: Ibuka has the willpower to give up on his vision, in favor of compromise and reconciliation.
strings.GNG_admit_it_tt:
It's time to admit the truth.
You can't do this alone.
Perhaps you should have done this from the start.
New £decision_icon_small decisions to reduce £GNG_riot_strength_texticon riot strength and £GNG_riot_radicalism_texticon radicalism are unlocked.
strings.GNG_admit_it_CCL_negotiation_tt:
To achieve any semblance of true closure, you must negotiate with the £GNG_CCL_texticon Committee of Chinese Labor.
It's the least you can do now.
strings.GNG_the_sky_cracks_desc:
I've gotten so much information from these bastards over the past few months of riots and disorder. And now I'm going to put it to good use. I'll go and sic every single armed man in Guangdong on these illiterates. No holds barred.

Send in the security officers, the police, the militia, hell, even the fucking Kenpeitai. If the IJA want in they're welcome; I don't give a shit anymore. Ride these traitors down until they learn their place. No need for me or them to show 'restraint' or 'kindness'. Give no quarter. Show no mercy. Keep attacking until these ingrates obey my will; if not, well, I am not responsible for the consequences.
strings.GNG_the_iron_grasp_desc:
An autonomous chain of command in the police force? Nonsense, I've got absolutely no need for such things. Why exactly do those blue-shirts have to function outside of my control? Don't they understand that Fujitsu is Guangdong and Guangdong is Fujitsu?

I'll subsume the police into Fujitsu Limited, make it just another unit of my militias. It is better this way; things will work faster, and be more efficient. All the better to shut these ungrateful rioters up for good.
strings.GNG_the_invisible_hand_desc:
I've gotten so much information from these bastards over the past few months of riots and disorder. I can put it to use to sic every armed man in Guangdong on them, yes, but there is something else I can do that's even better.

I'll order every single corporation in Guangdong to lay off every single individual even remotely associated with these damned riots. It will leave them with no means of subsistence, you say? Good. It's no more or less than they deserve.
strings.GNG_the_earth_trembles_desc:
What I have done is not enough. No, far from it. Now I am going to do something yet better. I am going to send thousands upon thousands of bulldozers and raze every single derelict neighborhood to the ground. It'll pave the way for better, more efficient projects in the future. But there's another bonus...

... it'll wipe those thrice-damned hotbeds of crime and potential hidey-holes and meeting places for rioters off the face of this blighted earth once and for all. Collateral damage is not a concern. What is important is that these pestholes be put out of my sight and out of my mind.
strings.GNG_not_even_in_the_face_of_armageddon_d:
Give the fruit of enlightenment to the masses, and they call you the Devil; flood four billion people off the face of the earth, and they call you God Almighty. I suppose nothing's stopping me from calling myself either of these; but titles are false, arbitrary, and if I were to do so I would have blasphemed against the one, objective truth:

I was right. On this planet full of unbridled idiocy I have myself, and only myself, to trust. Nobody else understands what matters. Nobody else understands what Guangdong wants. If this is the path I am destined to tread on my own, then so be it - I am my own person, and hell will freeze over before I submit to the whims of others ever again.

I was right, because I have proven myself right.

I was right, because I say so.
strings.GNG_their_space_desc:
You shameless, brutish good for nothing. Just how are you any better than the imperialist madmen in Germany, or that Manchurian sonofabitch Komai?
What? 'I'm not like them, I swear'? You lie! Only a Manchurian or an SS officer would be as brutal as you have been to these poor, poor people. If you want to avoid executing the Manchurian Plan with your own hands, show some mercy for once in your damned fool life.

Stop using brute-force methods to solve this mess you've gone and created. You of all people should know that brute-forcing isn't the way to get through a design problem 99% of the time. Ease up security measures, even if just a little. For the Gods' sake, show some respect for the lives and dignity of these fellow human beings of yours.
strings.GNG_our_apology_desc:
Look at yourself and tell me that over these last years of your rule - since Suzuki Teiichi and the Yasuda fuckup - that you haven't been wronging the innocent people of this state year after year in the name of your precious 'efficiency' and 'meritocracy'. You admit it? Good, then there's still some degree of hope left for you.

Have you got any suggestions on how to start fixing this mess you've gone and created?
'Go out and apologize'? 'Never mind if they accept, it'll at least show I'm starting to care for once in my life'? A perfect suggestion. Great minds think alike, clearly. Go out then, shoo, make the apology already!
strings.GNG_their_demands_desc:
Alright, so you cut those poor people some slack. Good on you; you clearly aren't a complete idiot. But let me be perfectly clear to you: this isn't even close to enough. Now it's time for you to do something that even Komai - to say nothing of Akio or Li or Matsushita - was always better at doing than you: listening to people.

Go out this very instant and listen to Guangdong's people for once. Listen to what those rioters have to ask of you - no, shut up, you're wrong to call them 'ungrateful vagabonds' - and then perform what those Kirishitans call an 'examination of conscience'. Come to terms with your myriad blunders.
Ask yourself: what foolhardy actions of yours brought them to this pass? How much misery have you caused them for a decade and more? And what exactly are you going to do to fix it?
strings.GNG_our_cries_desc:
Alright, so you went and apologized to them. Well done; your precious engineers from Sōtatsuchōnitsukōchijima Corporation or whatever the hell you call it clearly managed to avoid replacing your whole brain with the silicon you so fetishize. But this isn't even close to enough. Aren't you forgetting some people?
'Uh... do you mean the Japanese businessmen?' Got it in one. Good job... for you, anyway.

Go out immediately and reach out to the rest of the Japanese business community, even Akio, who I know you hate even though there's less and less reason to do so anymore. Go tell them that for once you're willing to work with them, that you'll give them a fair shake once more. I hate to have to resort to honorifics, but please, for your own sake, stop shutting yourself out like this.
strings.GNG_my_innermost_apocalypse_desc:
Was it worth it?

Time and time again I ask myself, as I shamble along the journey ever onwards. I gave it my all to a dream unfulfilled, only to witness reality crashing down in front of my very eyes. I made it my life's promise to tread my own path, to open up my own future, to live out the fifty years God has given me as my own uncontested man - only to go back on it all with clenched teeth. Was it worth it? What is it that I could do, then, if none of it ever was?

The answer remains lost. Nonetheless, I've turned my head, and taken my step in another direction.

Whereto, I do not know.
strings.GNG_and_so_the_light_shines_on: And So the Light Shines On...
strings.GNG_reignition_desc:
At last, it has ended; we have made an end of it all. The riots are now fully in the past tense. The IJA have been made to understand their place once and for all. At last the harrowing years that the nation and its people spent lurching from one form of confusion to another are over. At last the State of Guangdong is truly freed to live out great Ibuka Masaru's vision of a transistorized, competitive, uncompromising future!

But first, we must lick our wounds and repair the damage. Let recovery and reconstruction begin, while every cog of every level of society returns to its deserved place. The work will go on, and the show shall continue, as it always has been. As it should always be.
strings.GNG_reignition_tt: Those who see ruin and rubble in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong forget at their own peril: a fire shines brightest in darkest night.
strings.GNG_our_brightest_minds_unscathed_desc:
And who in their right mind can forget about the brilliant men of Fujitsu - the pioneers of the new technological order, bright lights of the new electronic golden age? Even when the daggers of hate and envy were pointed at them from every direction during the world-historical disaster that was the Oil Crisis, they persisted in their labors. Hell burned, and high water churned, but the Fujitsu worker kept working - kept innovating! Not even myriads of rioters could stop them!

As Guangdong moves on from the Riots and its prior history more generally, Fujitsu will need to find the right way to put these brilliant people to use, so as to ensure that we can continue innovating for all eternity.
strings.GNG_our_brightest_minds_unscathed_tt:
The future will outlive us.
£GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Fujitsu will outlive us.
strings.GNG_our_government_reinforced_desc:
Thank goodness! The Government of our State and its Legislative Council, for all their manifest inefficiencies and inherent design flaws, managed to survive the prospect of complete collapse and emerge in a more or less functional state. But we do well to remember that that could not have happened without Fujitsu's well-deserved dominance.

As the new era sets in, it is time for the Chief Executive and his team to check in on the state of the government. While he's at it, he'll want to reaffirm to the rest of the Japanese governing class of Guangdong that Fujitsu will - as always - remain the sole pillar upon which it can rest for support.
strings.GNG_our_government_reinforced_tt: What does not kill us, makes us stronger.
strings.GNG_our_citzenry_reinvigorated_desc:
Historians and sociologists will argue about the causes and effects of the Guangdong Riots for decades. But they, as the populace itself, have all clearly learned one major thing from this event and its aftermath. What is that lesson, you ask? It is that our model of excellence works, even in the face of crisis, and that not even some petty rabble-rousers can shake it off its foundations.

This truth has at last been etched into the hearts of all Guangdong's people. In this new age, whether or not they were part of the rioting rabble, they will see no reason not to happily abide by it, and work ceaselessly towards their very best forevermore.
strings.GNG_our_citzenry_reinvigorated_tt: The people will embrace the future - kicking and screaming if they must.
strings.GNG_and_so_the_light_shines_on_desc:
Yasuda. Matsuzawa. Suzuki. These names and others were once great powers and influence-holders in the State of Guangdong. They were known for their power and influence, but also for their inability to innovate in the face of changes in the world.

But now, with the passage of time and the rise of Chief Executive Ibuka Masaru, those influences are no more, mere relics of the past. Freed at last from the old, uninnovative, and incompetent reality, a recovered, strengthened and prepared Guangdong is at last ready to reach a new stage in its march forwards.

Though we may have compromised on some matters, and held firm on others, the end result is all one. Guangdong, with all of our effort - all of Fujitsu's effort - and under Ibuka's vision, is resplendent with technological might, and is at last placed to make claim to the title of the Jewel on the Pearl River.
strings.GNG_and_so_the_light_shines_on_tt: Here, in {year}, is the fruit of £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Ibuka Masaru's labors: a new £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong.
strings.GNG_from_this_beacon_of_greatness_desc:
Our Chief Executive, Ibuka Masaru, was never one to sit down quietly and accept whatever he was given, be it good or bad. We have all heard him say time and again that Guangdong cannot limit itself to being the brightest technological beacon of the Co-Prosperity Sphere; no, he says, our calling is greater than that.
Some time back, in fact, our esteemed Chief Executive's rhetoric reached a new height:

“No, it is not enough. We must prove once and for all that we are in the right. We have no need for slave labor, as the madmen in the Einheitspakt profess, nor for foolish overemphasis on 'civil liberties' and 'equality' like the bleeding hearts of the OFN. No, by meritocracy and innovation we shall benefit and shine upon all mankind and pass the best that the Westerners - and anyone else - have to offer.
As we finally approach our rightful place in the global limelight, the other peoples of this beautiful, tormented Earth will see the fruits of our intellect. They will behold the results your adherence to my vision has brought us.”

“Then, they will sit down and LEARN.”
strings.GNG_from_this_beacon_of_greatness_tt: From the Pearl River Delta, shines the future of the world.
strings.GNG_upon_our_hearts_desc:
Everything is going back into motion; the economy stabilizes, the people at last calm down. The past is further and further away from us, like Kōshū in the rear-view mirror as we drive south to Honkon or north to the frontier. But perhaps we can take a moment to reflect on our history before we fully leave it behind - our founding, the eras of Suzuki and his predecessors, the struggles that our Chief Executive went through to build up the State of Guangdong of today.

True, Guangdong remains a mere patch of land close to the South China Sea, trammeled in by warlords and revolutionaries to our north and the unmoving waters to our south. But we have never been the sort of people to allow ourselves to be bogged down by physical limits. For we took a broken legacy in hand and made it new, surpassing even the highest height of the old. We have every right to take pride in that, and every reason to use it to make Guangdong even greater than it already is.
strings.GNG_upon_our_hearts_tt: Look upon your creation, and tell me what you see.
strings.GNG_across_the_seas_desc:
O great Japan, our fair homeland, the originator of our existence! The chain to which our fates were once tied, until the coming of Ibuka Masaru!
No longer shall we subordinate ourselves to you as we march into the brave new world that you have built. Under our honored Chief Executive, we have surpassed you, O Japan, even as you once surpassed the Europeans and Chinese. When we forged our own destiny, we had no need of your help. When we innovated and created glorious things unheard of in human history, we did not require your assistance.

O our brethren, we thank you for your love and kindness to us; we salute and honor you as our compatriots. But now hear if you have ears: we are no longer your servants or tributaries! Granted, we will fulfill our duties to you and to the Emperor. We will do our duty for the cause of Pan-Asianism. But let us be clear: it will only be on our terms, not yours!
strings.GNG_across_the_seas_tt: And what does £GNG_japanese_nation_texticon Tokyo want now?
strings.GNG_across_the_land_desc:
The numbers - be they financial, production, manpower, or anything else - continually increase, all thanks to Guangdong's brilliance and Ibuka's vision. At last we are freed to leave the brutish, backwards industrial hellhole that is Kwantung behind. But it seems that Manchukuo is no longer our only rival in the Sphere.

The Republic of China, the 'motherland' of Guangdong, has begun a frankly admirable process of modernization. Their 'Five Modernizations' seem to have equipped them to start up firms and initiatives of their own - but it matters not. Whatever challenges or opportunities the land to the north brings, they will only prove Ibuka's point that the Guangdong that we build is unmatched in its technological power and might.
strings.GNG_across_the_land_tt: We no longer measure £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon ourselves against £MAN_manchukuo_texticon Xinjing; instead, we pay attention to £GNG_chinese_nation_texticon Nanjing and Shanghai...
strings.GNG_against_the_coming_night_desc:
How high we've ascended, atop this zenith of truth; how far we've journeyed, as we depart the eons past.

But alas, devious are the machinations of our cosmos. Whispers penetrate our borders, telling of conflict, of aggression, of cataclysmic schemes already afoot; stormclouds converge, swirl, and roar across the East China Sea, their all-embracing darkness shrouding the skies. No matter our wishes, no matter all our endeavors, there are things that remain beyond our control. There always are.

Onwards we stride, for there is only the future ahead of us.
strings.GNG_against_the_coming_night_tt:
A neon light in the darkness, against threats both within and without:
May £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Fujitsu's glory shine forevermore!
strings.GNG_the_copper_crown_on_our_brow: The Copper Crown on Our Brow
strings.GNG_cattle_dont_work_hard_enough: Cattle Do Not Work Hard Enough
strings.GNG_a_gift_to_the_powers_that_be: A Gift to the Powers That Be
strings.GNG_chief_executive_komai_desc:
Indeed divine destiny has favored Komai Kenichirō, chairman of Hitachi - the electronics subsidiary of the Mangyō Zaibatsu - as he has secured outstanding triumphs over rival elements in both the Legislative Council and the civilian sector, enabling his current residence in the Office of the Chief Executive of Guangdong and thus his dominance over the majority of the state's executive apparatus.

Ever faithful adherents of Pan-Asianism, Chief Executive Komai and his loyal associates have expressed the open wish to fundamentally restructure Guangdong's political, social, and economic systems along the lines of Manchukuo, the industrial powerhouse of the Co-Prosperity Sphere as well as Mangyō's base of operations. Now possessing sufficient executive power to realize his noble ideals, our Chief Executive shall sponsor the consolidation of Mangyō's status as a profitable and formidable economic entity across the seas - and above all, the reinstatement of Guangdong as an exemplar of prosperity and a Jewel of the South truly deserving of its name.

Certain mistakes must be amended if we are to proceed, however...
strings.GNG_the_emergency_relations_ordinance_de:
We are in grave danger. The State of Guangdong, as it currently stands, is confronted by an immediate threat poised to hinder its progress and compromise its very foundation of existence - and the root of such a malady, we have discovered, is Guangdong's longstanding internal instability stemming from its discordant and self-cannibalizing governing institutions. Drastic complications require equally drastic countermeasures, which only a sufficiently centralized governing body can deliver.

Through the rational and persuasive words of our Chief Executive the other representatives have begun to see reason in the Emergency Regulations Ordinance, which is expected to receive unanimous approval in the Legislative Council. Its purpose: the reallocation of all remaining executive power to our Chief Executive and his loyal subordinates, thus permitting swift and decisive elimination of Guangdong's existential threat and safeguarding its future for years to come.

Only then can we begin the work on our grand design...
strings.GNG_the_emergency_relations_ordinance_tt: With this, all shall know: compliance is the easy way out.
strings.GNG_boots_on_the_ground_desc:
Guangdong is akin to a gleaming pearl, prosperous and exquisite, yet it is fragile and friable, with the possibility of its beauty crumbling to dust under the malevolent boot of the dissidents, lurking and present in every minute crevice. The copious amounts of unenlightened individuals who oppose the status of law and order threaten the grand designs of the Chief Executive and our inchoate administration, an omnipresent sinister spectre looming over the state. To effectively demonstrate the futility of opposition, their presence shall be met with the fire and steel of our esteemed security forces, assisting the dutiful Kenpeitai on the ground.

No single person, young or elderly, male or female, shall escape reprisal for dissent. The security and welfare of Guangdong is to be guaranteed under any and all circumstances, exceptions are nonexistent. May the principled residents of the Pearl River Delta rejoice under our watchful guardianship.
strings.GNG_boots_on_the_ground_tt: The £GNG_kenpeitai_texticon Kenpeitai are our stalwart shield - and our merciless sword.
strings.GNG_fingers_on_your_throat_desc: The issue of the omnipresent dissidents and agitators continues to plague us, an abhorrent malaise that has extended its vile tentacles around the once pristine pearl of Guangdong. These dissidents threaten the security of the state, and must be exterminated. The objects and institutions of Guangdong that naturally benefit the forces of opposition, like the press and their fruitless publications, will certainly place the state in great peril. The independent publishers and their hazardous literature only serve as a mouthpiece for the spread of the dissident agenda, and as such must not be tolerated. We will demand that the presses halt, any futile semblance of resistance will be met with our security forces and the crackle of gunfire. We must not allow the ideologies of the enemy to be exported to our populace, and in turn, allow the desecration of the shining pearls.
strings.GNG_isolate_the_activists_desc: With the threats and hazards of Guangdong's surface repressed and kept in check, a new menace has emerged in the decrepit underground societies of the state. A new species of dissidents, a group of people who rally against the business practices that composes the foundation of Guangdong's core apparatus. A group of people who lambast our illustrious administration with unjustified criticism, openly decrying our Chief Executive and his wise policies. These people will be treated akin to any other dissidents, a threat. We will silence their voices and interrupt their sessions, ensuring that their presence is limited to nothing more than a whimper, greatly reducing their influence upon the public consciousness. As with any other dissidents, force will be applied if necessary, if any open opposition is offered, the security forces will not be restrained. The populace of Guangdong must come to realize the futility of intransigence.
strings.GNG_the_adrenal_scent_of_fear_desc: With the extensive expansion of our security forces and increased enforcement of policies on the streets, the safety of Guangdong's virtuous citizenry expands evermore. Seditious individuals, once prevalent and commonplace in the streets and alleyways, are now no longer seen. Through the presence of our security forces and the infallibility of the rubber baton, the glorious and radiant luster of the pearls of Guangdong have once again begun to reemerge. Despite our evident progress, much of our population remain apprehensive, their heads filled with irrational anxieties and concerns. However, their fear is only a beneficial sign that demonstrates the extent of our reach across the state. A clear symbol of the inevitable success of our regime's valiant efforts to exterminate dissent.
strings.GNG_a_city_of_prisoners_desc: The cities of Guangdong are undoubtedly its greatest pride. An efficient yet exquisite construct where progress and order reign supreme. However glorious these marvels of capability may be, the dense and chaotic nature of the streets is the perfect breeding ground for dissent. We have achieved much in addressing these glaring issues, the prominent increase of the presence of our esteemed security forces being the most evident demonstration of such. Due to our increased measures of the preservation of order, much of the population now prefer to simply remain in their residences, only leaving to perform essential tasks or commute to work. This has proven to be greatly beneficial for our cause, as the decreased presence of people in public has firmly discouraged attitudes of dissent and disobedience from ever arising on the soil and tarmac of the state.
strings.GNG_kick_down_every_door_desc:
The vacated streets of Guangdong now prosper as the organized and prevalent presence of dissidents have been nearly eradicated. Our venerated security forces have dutifully and effectively secured the public premises of the cities, its alleyways, storefronts, intersections made comfortably calm. Despite this, the conniving forces of dissent continue to lurk within the urban expanses of Guangdong, no longer in the open, but behind closed doors.

The compact and omnipresent tenements and apartments lining the streets are akin to nests of opposition, their decrepit ideologies and misconstrued creeds festering from building to building. We will demonstrate that the safety they presume is nothing more than an illusion, their measly wooden and rusted steel doors offer trivial protection against the forceful boots of order. No homes are to be exceptions, any person considered to be harboring dissenting beliefs will be susceptible for a mandatory inspection. They will learn of the fruitlessness of evasion, they cannot escape our grasps.
strings.GNG_kick_down_every_door_tt: The people will learn to obey - to understand that their worlds have irrevocably changed.
strings.GNG_the_copper_crown_on_our_brow_desc:
Given our Chief Executive himself is but a devoted subordinate of the economic juggernaut Mangyō Zaibatsu, it is only advisable that our connection and partnership with our counterparts in Manchukuo remain as palpable as possible. Closer integration into the greater Mangyō network would doubtlessly grant us countless privileges - including, in particular, access to Mangyō's employed security forces pool, which will be of immense assistance in handling certain domestic disturbances while alleviating the need for Home Islands interference in related matters.

Because no measure is too extreme in the face of disobedience.
strings.GNG_teeth_and_hate_desc:
It is the Kenpeitai's swift mobilization as well as outstanding surveillance and military capabilities that has earned its place as the sentinel of Pan-Asianism ever since the outbreak of the Great East Asia War, a most honorable title to which the passage of time has only lent more credence. Should our local security presence appear overwhelmed by the recent dissident activity surge, we have no reason to refrain from summoning Kenpeitai reinforcements from all corners of the Sphere and employ their anti-insurgent expertise to the fullest.

Because no measure is too extreme in the face of disobedience.
strings.GNG_the_executives_speech_desc:
It is natural that distance bears dissonance. Mass swarms of dissidents have rallied against our consolidation of power, regrettably few among them aware that our Chief Executive is, in reality, a paragon of untainted benevolence; it is precisely owing to benevolence that he has elected to establish his administration among the untamed, disorderly banks and factories of Guangdong, wishing nothing more than to return a semblance of stability and prosperity to this patch of once-fertile soil.

To dissipate such detrimental misconceptions circulating within our society, our Chief Executive has found it apt to prepare a direct address to the citizenry, slated for nationwide broadcast across all television and radio channels. With utmost sincerity, we will inform them of our virtuous guardianship over all aspects of domestic affairs, and assure them that order and harmony will be duly and rightfully restored to their livelihood.

And what else can they do but rejoice?
strings.GNG_the_executives_speech_tt: We inaugurate a new age of order, productivity, and progress - and we will brook no opposition.
strings.GNG_pretend_to_care_desc:
Tolerance. The most subdued yet most alluring of virtues, the moral beacon thousands of men and women find themselves flocking to in reverence. Let tolerance be our approach to the rebellious and disgruntled populace, with which we shall subdue Hitachi's activities, and reiterate our benevolence as well as our willingness to rescind all regulatory measures from civilian affairs, provided enough cooperation and understanding on our citizens' part.

So they will have no choice but to behave.
strings.GNG_neglect_and_abuse_desc:
Tolerance. The Achilles' heel of many a prosperous empire, the heinous termite hole etched into the majestic monument of order and eroding its integrity from within. Tolerance is what permitted subversive elements to ravage our civilian and administrative sectors, and tolerance we shall grant them no more. We will formally declare dissident activity as criminal offense, informing our populace that only those loyal and cooperative to Hitachi deserve redemption and a chance at survival in our new state.

So they will have no choice but to obey.
strings.GNG_at_the_foot_of_profit_desc: The future of Guangdong lays just within our reach, and we must do whatever it takes to secure it within our grasp and initiate the economic revolution. We will now begin the process of initiating protocols and measures to take control of the economy of Guangdong - with the help of our loyal friends at Mangyō, of course.
strings.GNG_at_the_foot_of_profit_tt: There is only one thing that matters: £GNG_Hitachi_texticon Hitachi's glory, and its glory alone.
strings.GNG_corporate_sanitation_desc: By taking advantage of now having state funds at our disposal, we will buy up rival companies weakened by the economic restructuring measures. Hitachi will become the primary shareholder of these corporations, neutering them from engaging in effective competition or resisting any further government actions.
strings.GNG_financial_haruspicy_desc: Irritating corporations will soon only exist in the annals of history and financial records, as our Chief Executive has sanctioned numerous acts to extirpate whatever structure or organization that remains of these resistant establishments. We have appropriated the funds and monetary resources of the state to our security agencies, dispatched to seize and confiscate the properties, capital and assets of various dismantled and impotent corporations formerly operating across Guangdong and the Three Pearls. These initiatives are, of course, committed under the direct authority and permission of our illustrious Chief Executive, initiatives that will lead to the centralization of the economy and the consumer markets under the all-encompassing jurisdiction of Hitachi. The entrails of carcasses may still prove to be beneficial to our cause.
strings.GNG_vulture_the_remains_desc: As we continue upon our righteous endeavor to resuscitate and restore Guangdong's debilitated economy to its proper state, it is required that we eliminate pestiferous obstacles preventing steady progress, some of which have manifested themselves in the form of corporations. Akin to wild brambles and thistles, we must clear these nettlesome corporations, many of which have already been infiltrated and crippled due to our policies, with the machete of state funds and executive decrees. As most of them have already been immobilized, the only thing left to do is to bring down the blade upon the foliage and exterminate their presence within the economy. Our Chief Executive will enact several initiatives to disassemble and dissolve the remnants of resistant corporations, and they shall disappear into the records, vine by vine.
strings.GNG_cornered_survivors_desc: Though our endeavor of extermination and growth has proved to be beneficial and extensive, we must not allow the remaining corporations to revel in their moment of relief. The strength and will of Hitachi must be demonstrated and made clear for every single corporate entity present throughout Guangdong, our Chief Executive does not overlook. Any corporation still operating within our spheres of influence will be forced or coerced into partnership with Hitachi, whether that equates to becoming a productive subsidiary or being merged entirely into the corporate apparatus of Hitachi. We have demonstrated our dominance across Guangdong's economic stage, let there not be examples of resilience against our might.
strings.GNG_under_new_management_desc: The economy has been torn apart from the inside out and then mopped up cleanly at the hands of Hitachi, by the order of Komai. In the new and improved economy that we have created, Hitachi holds a firm monopoly over the functions of society and has become indistinguishable from the government - just as planned.
strings.GNG_under_new_management_tt: When every billboard has a £GNG_Hitachi_texticon Hitachi logo on it, then £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong shall understand who rules.
strings.GNG_a_merchants_republic_desc:
It seems our path to the future has manifested itself clearer than ever, as Hitachi now sits resolutely in command of Guangdong's governance, economy, and civilian sectors, the reins of power firmly within our palm. Hark, however, and behind the crystalline skylines of Kōshū, Honkon, and Makao an ominous rumbling echoes. Thunderstorms of deceit, ever elusive and ever ferocious, constantly lurk beyond the horizon scheming to devour the foundations of prosperity we have so meticulously assembled.

But no matter. Never a feeble radical like Morita Akio, a hidebound pen-pusher like Matsushita Masaharu, nor a delusional technocrat like Ibuka Masaru, our Chief Executive will serve dutifully as the vanguard of Guangdong's rejuvenation, the ray of enlightenment to disperse the storm clouds of barbarism. With Mangyō's full might the engine of progress shall march on, undeterred and uninhibited; and by the time our grand design finally attains perfection...

...all will have known their place within.
strings.GNG_a_merchants_republic_tt: Komai sits high upon the loci of wealth and power, and sees £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong lying prostrate before him.
strings.GNG_the_breakneck_speed_of_success_desc:
The dream of this industrious land, where men are raised on the virgin soils home to our people's success, is one familiar to the nation of Guangdong. Our citizens chase this dream instinctively, and we too will advance the prosperity of our nation on the Pearl River to find a future among riches.

No man, however, among us is more willing to chase after this dream than Chief Executive Komai. With the flick of a pen and the print of a stamp, the toils of the state's great citizenry will be organised behind a collective effort for prosperity and affluence. Together, let us prime our economy to prepare for the final leap to greatness.
strings.GNG_the_breakneck_speed_of_success_tt: Profit waits for no man - and those who can't keep up are of no use to us.
strings.GNG_annul_regulatory_codes_desc:
How can we possibly hope to generate wealth with a belt asphyxiating the potential of corporations working within our borders? It would be asinine to suggest that there is enough breathing room for the company to operate on the Pearl River Delta; if we want wealth to flourish, action simply must be taken now.

Chief Executive Komai will see to it that restrictions and regulations that corporations must abide by are loosened significantly. As we throw statutes into the paper incinerator, our prosperous future will glimmer before us; products will be manufactured, and profits will be generated - why stand in the way whilst the corporation toils to realize Guangdong's potential?
strings.GNG_gutting_social_spending_desc:
Allocating the entire portions of the budget to the development of lazy indulgences is not only a waste of resources, but a waste of our potential. We have no need to invest small fortunes into the development of green spaces, nor pour millions into the funding of mental health care schemes like our predecessors.

There is no alternative to solving these issues that punch holes in our pockets other than severing funding altogether. It's a measure Komai determines to be of the utmost importance, after all. Not only will we be saving money, now and in the future, but both workers and the government can shift their attention to economic matters exclusively.
strings.GNG_gutting_social_spending_tt: Our already low social spending will be limited to 75% to save money.
strings.GNG_let_the_roof_collapse_desc:
It has long been a concern for our administration to tackle the restrictions of labor regulations; they have been a drain on private spending within the operation of businesses, as heaps of wealth are thrown into the fire to guarantee loosely-defined codes alluding to 'workers protections'.

To sever every impediment clinging to our ankles as we strive for greatness, we must tear up these damned regulations to save corporations the money. Wealth is spent in better places than suicide nets or air ventilation; we can trust our corporate partners to make the decisions best for the country, in this regard. After all, we have more than enough in our citizenry to replace those caught up in 'accidental deaths'.
strings.GNG_hunt_down_surviving_regulators_desc:
An industry should be allowed to develop and prosper, it is the responsibility of the administration to fully guarantee and oversee that society functions according and satisfactory to the industry of the nation. However, throughout the years of Guangdong's existence, she has been constantly and consistently burdened by the impractical and counterproductive regulations and arbitrary rules set in place by corrupt bureaucrats and over-lenient bleeding hearts that were the staples of our predecessors. As such, we have begun efforts and motions to eradicate these forces of inefficiency plaguing our economy and preventing it from truly operating at an optimal status.

The worker does not require excessive amenities and protections, for they are compensated by their wage. Regulations are benchmarks of a decadent past that will be exterminated article by article, their memories and presence will be relegated to historical footnotes. The remaining practitioners and men who still abide by these outdated guidelines will be taught the errors of their ways, willing or unwilling. Productivity cannot be hindered by the human condition.
strings.GNG_blood_soaked_metal_desc:
The opulence and magnificence of the pearls of Guangdong are defined by the steel and foundries of industry. Industry serves as the essential component of the economy and livelihood of the state, any attempt to hinder the industry is akin to seditious behavior against one's own administration. Hitachi has been a proud and withstanding embodiment of the power and profits of a productive and substantial industry, our managers focused, our workforce diligent, our assembly lines active and operating at any moment.

Of course, as prudent and righteous overseers of the nation, we will not interfere with or block the everlasting strive for increased profits or progression. Our Chief Executive's intelligent approach to the management of one of Guangdong's fundamental institutions is undoubtedly a large contributor to its prosperity and success, allowing our earnest workforce to represent the prowess of Guangdong's influence, working assiduously day and night, true heroes of manufacturing. A nation's prosperity is not granted, it is earned, for the tunnels of the mines and the conveyor belts of the factories are what brings prosperity upon us.
strings.GNG_cattle_dont_work_hard_enough_desc:
The workers are the backbone of a thriving industrial force. They comprise the numbers that push Guangdong's towards an efficient and glorious future. It is of no doubt to us that in order for the nation to truly prosper, the worker needs to be at optimal productivity. However, due to the miscalculations and lackluster management of our apathetic and utterly incompetent predecessors, the once diligent and assiduous workforce has largely been degraded to a mere shadow of what it used to be.

This is unacceptable. It is our duty and responsibility to correct the mistakes and indiscretions of the past lingering in the present, and it is our duty and responsibility to edit the attitude and priorities of the worker. Expectations will be heavily raised, and industrial and production quotas alongside it, it must be made evident that their precious wages are earned, not granted. Working hours will increase as additional hours are added to the work day, as well as the implementation of compulsory unpaid overtimes, in order to further assure the employers. By heightening our requirements, it simply strengthens the existing industrial structure of Guangdong, expunging all traces of excess and indolence.
strings.GNG_the_submission_order_desc:
Though the market may be an open place for experimentation and plentiful opportunities, the priorities of the benefits of the state and Guangdong must come first. Over the years, the once lucrative and wide markets of the Three Pearls have been diluted and oversaturated by an influx of inexperienced and locally run businesses, who directly or indirectly compete with the existing monopolies of established corporations that comprise the foundation of Guangdong, our Hitachi being a prime example.

The solution is evident, we must do what is necessary to force the hands of the smaller businesses to ensure harmony and prosperity on the economic stage. Certain companies who specialize in the markets where Hitachi and other large corporations hold notable sway or monopolies will be either directly annexed, divided, or willingly or unwillingly signed into contracts of cooperation. The fruits of profit will be distributed throughout the economy, but the weeds acting as a hindrance to the harvest must be removed first.
strings.GNG_the_price_of_profit_desc:
Our exalted Chief Executive has presided over numerous sublime achievements, in stark and utter contrast to the inertia and ineffectual efforts of our imbecilic and inept predecessors, a radiant precedent that is to be followed by generations to come.

Undoubtedly, the establishment of Hitachi's supremacy upon Guangdong's markets and economy is one of the greatest achievements realized under the guidance of our Chief Executive, through his position in the Legislative Council, of which he is rightfully deserving. Yet, the dream has not been completely fulfilled; the ripe and plump fruits of profit dangling from the branches of dominance have yet to be entirely harvested, therefore we must continue to utilize the powers of the Legislative Council to ensure that our endeavors encounter no obstacles or resistance. Under our illustrious administration, the Council is to remain a tool: Another opportunity for growth in our ability to reach our economic imperatives. One where our presence and support are to be guaranteed by our loyal and steadfast corporate sponsors. Our path to prosperity is fixed, our journey aided by the powers imbued within the Legislative Council and the backing of our benefactors. None shall oppose our ascension.
strings.GNG_the_great_machine_desc:
Guangdong is a nation with immense capability, her workforce eager and diligent, her economy fruitful and prosperous. Guangdong's structure, her economic apparatus is a system suited for welfare and success if guided with wisdom and prudence, able to produce remarkable benefits and profits. Unfortunately, she has not been navigated with efficiency and care towards glory and economic triumph, but instead led astray towards a perennial and perpetual cycle of decay and negligence.

When our enlightened Chief Executive grasped the reins of power with his skillful hands, Guangdong's potential was shepherded towards her intended destiny. As of present, the ceaseless journey towards prosperity continues, presided over by our administration, but it seems that the engine has yet to reach full throttle. Any assistance would be of great benefit to our efforts, and it seems that our charitable benefactor of Mangyō is willing to offer their support. Our partnership would lead Guangdong into a greater era of stability, one that ensures a glorious and profitable future, by any means necessary.
strings.GNG_the_great_machine_tt: Soon, £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong shall work like clockwork - with £GNG_Hitachi_texticon Komai as clockmaker extraordinaire.
strings.GNG_the_only_friendship_we_need_desc:
“Past experience, if not forgotten, is a guide for the future.”

A prudent and perennial adage whose substance continues to remain relevant despite the prolonged passage of time. Our Chief Executive, in his intellectual acuity, perceives the old saying as a hint to employ the models and methods of past successful endeavors, whether they be in antiquity or in the contemporary era.

A shining example of a system that has led to economic triumph would be the process currently employed in the verdant fields and urban expanses of Manchukuo, a nation that embodies efficiency and prosperity. The factories and workhouses of the northeast are absent of the malady that is apathy or sloth, their streets and settlements cleansed of any semblance of dissent by the deafening crackles of gunfire. The entity responsible for the accomplishments of Manchukuo is our greatest backer, the honorable Mangyō Corporation. In order to attain success for Guangdong, we will abide by the precedents set by Mangyō in the north; we will invite them into our corporate structure and put our industry under their capable and omniscient supervision. The inclusion of Mangyō is the optimal procedure for the replication of Manchukuo's economic miracle, their experience has not been forgotten and will act as a guide for how we proceed.
strings.GNG_the_only_friendship_we_need_tt: £GFX_MAN_mangyo_texticon Mangyō shall provide the men and expertise to lubricate £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's industry as never before.
strings.GNG_slicing_through_red_tape_desc: There still exist legal codes, regulations, and restrictions buried deep within the law that previously served to protect Guangdong's administration from what was considered to be the influence of 'foreign' interests. We have no use for this, and they only serve as a hindrance to our plans and an opportunity for our internal enemies to take advantage of. We will get rid of them entirely, to finally be able to completely embrace the aid offered by Mangyō.
strings.GNG_a_model_worth_replicating_desc: The operations undertaken by Mangyō in Manchukuo have resulted in their immense growth and unprecedented generation of profits under the aegis of Mangyō. Removing ourself from further interaction with these brilliant businessmen would be no better than robbing Guangdong of a similarly grand future. Let us emulate Mangyō's practices in this country as well on the basis of their valued advice, in order to attain the true prosperity that we seek.
strings.GNG_in_your_name_only_desc: If we took the additional step of offering Mangyō exclusive contracts, the standards of services offered by them and save us a significant amount of money, while strengthening our relationship with our reputable and distinguished partners. It is not just a necessity to work alongside Mangyō, it is a privilege, and offering these contracts to them can only benefit our economic development.
strings.GNG_an_offering_to_our_patrons_desc: Guangdong and her economy is on a fixed course, barreling towards the prospects of financial triumph and success, shepherded dutifully by our astute Chief Executive; but alas, the engine of the nation cannot continue to operate with efficiency if there is a lack of foreign and necessary support. Therefore, we warmly invite the Mangyō Corporation with our amiable and appreciative gratitude, as they act as our benefactors that will provide an abundance of needed assistance. We will repay their benevolent efforts by selling them our private debt, as we trust that they shall manage and handle our accounts and capital with efficiency and attentiveness. As we continue to place our trust and faith in Mangyō, we hope that Mangyō will aid us in the replication of Manchukuo's economic miracle that they were responsible for, as it is a guiding beacon of success on our journey towards prosperity.
strings.GNG_more_than_a_guest_desc: In the Mangyō Corporation, we see not a tool or an expendable or superfluous accessory for our growth, but instead, a reliable and trustworthy economic partner and patron that will guide us towards and past the gates of prosperity. Mangyō is an organization that has proven to be of extreme benefit to us, they have aided and supported us in our previous endeavors of economic reorganization and assisted us in generating profits and capital that we could not have imagined. A sizable portion of the desirable credit of Guangdong's success under the administration of Hitachi rightfully belongs to Mangyō, achieving and accomplishing more for her benefit than any other existing entity aside from Hitachi and our Chief Executive himself. It is evident that we must ensure that our productive partnership must continue to proliferate into Guangdong's future, as if it is maintained, it will bring upon us an endless era of prosperity and plenteousness.
strings.GNG_more_than_a_guest_tt: Under £GFX_MAN_mangyo_texticon Mangyō and £MAN_manchukuo_texticon Manchukuo's guiding hand, £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong sees the light of Asia's future.
strings.GNG_a_friend_from_high_places_desc: One of the fundamental pillars of Guangdong's economy would be its lucrative yet erratic and volatile stock exchange, an institution that is essential for the transformation and reestablishment of Guangdong's economy, where fortunes are gained and lost. If we are to allow the Mangyō Corporation to provide us with optimal assistance, we must welcome them into our various economic institutions, one of which is the stock exchange, along with several other financial sectors. If our nation is to become a glorious paradigm of economic success, an example that is to be followed by countless future generations and states, we must greet our benefactors into our affairs with open arms and receive them with grace, there are no other options.
strings.GNG_a_friend_from_high_places_tt: We shall open the financial floodgates, and £MAN_manchukuo_texticon Manchukuo's money shall inundate £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong.
strings.GNG_stack_the_deck_desc: Now that we have trimmed the excess fat of the economy of Guangdong, we have no use for the leftovers. However, Mangyō may be interested in making them useful, and we have much to gain by selling liquidated produce and industry to divisions of Mangyō, from a quick fortune to the long-term favor of our patrons. Guangdong is the home of Asian innovation, and we will continue to carry on the legacy of our forefathers and allies at Mangyō.
strings.GNG_a_flow_of_wealth_desc: Our partners in Mangyō bring with them necessary devices of development from the north, leaving a golden trail of wealth behind them, a result of their investments and attention. In order for us to effectively reap the benefits of Mangyō's involvement, we must not shut off the gates of our economy. As the bountiful treasures of the northeast trickle down the Pearl River, are we to disrupt its entrance with an immovable dam? No, for it would be preposterous. We must keep our gates open and our rivers unblocked, as the profits brought on by Mangyō will water our verdant meadows and ripen the fruits and products of industrialization and economic prosperity.
strings.GNG_a_staff_of_nissans_best_desc: As we continue upon the endeavor of the inclusion of the Mangyō Corporation into our economic apparatus and affairs, we must account for all the fruits they may bring to our nation and soon to be a thriving economy. An asset possessed by Mangyō we must not neglect or dismiss is the significant amount of talent present within their corporation. We must employ and make use of the skilled directors and executives of Mangyō at our disposal, appoint them to effective positions in our administration and corporate structure. Soon, our bureaucracies are bound to be filled with exceptionally talented and experienced individuals, destined to lead Guangdong to triumph and prosperity, a nation that will be unparalleled in success except for the powerhouse of Manchukuo itself.
strings.GNG_a_gift_to_the_powers_that_be_desc: Our partners, or rather patrons, at Mangyō are an inarguably impressive corporate force raking in astounding profits from all across Asia as they constantly strive to maximize their industrial and economic output. We will wedge our way into Mangyō's sphere of influence, and join them in their never ending march onwards into the future of economic progress and maximized profit by transferring public services of Guangdong to the Mangyō balance sheet.
strings.GNG_a_staff_of_nissans_best_tt: £GFX_MAN_mangyo_texticon Mangyō will pay for 15% of our Social and Military costs.
strings.GNG_warm_breath_down_our_neck_desc:
Our Chief Executive is a man who embodies enlightened and prudent thinking, adaptable and knowledgeable. He has enacted several astute initiatives that have all benefited Guangdong exceptionally, the serenity of the pearls being restored gradually with the passing of every decree and the announcement of every measure. A key decision made by our Chief Executive that has proven to be extraordinarily fruitful and rewarding, a demonstration of his wisdom, would be the continued partnership with our patron, the Mangyō Corporation, a title they have rightfully earned.

Mangyō has supplied us with bountiful support and assistance, in both the forms of physical assets and mental tenets and advice, entangling Hitachi and Mangyō in an inseparable web of financial involvement and mutual benefit. The omnipresent presence and engagement that Mangyō possesses are apparent in all facets of Guangdong's economic apparatus, further propelling us towards a future of continued prosperity and success. If Guangdong and Hitachi are to join and challenge the greatest economies currently present upon this Earth, it would be under the benevolent and crucial auspices of Mangyō, and under the efficient system of Manchukuo.
strings.GNG_warm_breath_down_our_neck_tt: With £MAN_manchukuo_texticon Manchurian money in hand and their honeyed words in our ears, £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong will surely climb every higher.
strings.GNG_extending_the_state_of_emergency_des:
We are in grave danger, and we remain so despite the apparent tranquility descending upon our streets.

Maggots don't eat; they infest. Maggots won't just come out under broad daylight - no, they'd rather wriggle in their petty heaps of rot in the shadows, defiling our sacred nation with their revolting stench like the wretched vermin they are.

How else are we to exterminate those colony after colony of maggots, if not pry open every house, every sewer, and decontaminate it all with the fieriest of fires? How else are our dearest Chief Executive and his lieutenants to deliver Guangdong her promised salvation, if not liberate her from weaklings, plotters and degenerates everywhere by rooting them out right where they hide? There's no way around, no alternative in sight; we are in grave danger, and there's never too much we can do to rid ourselves of it.

We will snuff out the embers of treachery, one by one.
strings.GNG_extending_the_state_of_emergency_tt: Seizing control was the easy part. Securing it will require a more thorough cleansing of the rot.
strings.GNG_introduce_a_curfew_desc: No longer will curfew be a “safe way out” conjured up by some spineless parasites within our security forces; from now on it is to be the norm, the first wall of sacred fire to purify our alleyways and boulevards. The serenity of the night is no place for scheming no-good loiterers, nor for sentimental civilians whining to our officers in paltry want; and if they so wish to prostitute themselves as pests upon our nation, what choice do we have but to sic the flames upon them and leave their smoldering corpses to oblivion?
strings.GNG_blood_streaked_sidewalks_desc:
Firearms are the ultimate instrument, the spark to ignite Guangdong's fiery nirvana; and firearms the Kenpeitai's warehouses and Manchukuo's steelworks will provide, assembled and gifted to us with uttermost care and camaraderie.

Let our loyal officers, with the might of the firearm in hand and with righteous fury in their hearts, set ablaze our defiled soil and expel the treacherous, cowering vermin from whatever filth they bury themselves in; the next time our Chief Executive sets his watchful gaze upon the Jewel of the South it shall have been baptized by blood, cleansed of the stench of rot forevermore.
strings.GNG_houses_of_terror_desc:
Pre-Hitachi criminal investigation and interrogation procedures were an utter farce. Too many summary executions, too much undeserved leniency given those sleazy rodents, one disgrace after another congregating into an utterly disgusting failure of law enforcement.

No more. Rats don't deserve freedom. Rats don't even deserve death. The only fate a captured rat deserves is scuttling on hot coal or drowning in its own sewage for eternity until it spews its innards out for us, or else it'll never see the light of day ever again.
strings.GNG_a_killers_muscle_memory_desc:
Rodents come in swarms, they always do - and within every swarm there is a hierarchical structure, with its own ranks of “senior” rats and “junior” rats and whatnot, some with more revolting propagandist bile congesting their entrails than others.

It is quite the regrettable setback, then, to have the most corpulent of those rats constantly waltzing past our crosshairs, leaving only bloodied, yelping pups in our cages. We might as well have them lined up against the wall and put a bullet in each of their filthy little brains, and proceed to dump their corpses in the backstreets as a display.
strings.GNG_the_utility_of_despair_desc:
Canines are quite the affable creature, they are - easily predicted, easily frightened, and easily manipulated into doing researchers' bidding. We are the researchers, pursuing the formula for Guangdong's renaissance; her society is a natural laboratory readily packed with witless canine subjects, some more subservient than others.

Implanting the mental associations of obedience with dog treats as well as insubordination with iron bars and mangled corpses within the Sphere's greatest doghouse, then, should prove as much a cakewalk as it is a necessity.
