strings.GNG_meet_with_CCL_notables_desc: We will organize a proper meeting with some of the leaders from the £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL to work on a potential compromise that addresses some of their concerns.
strings.GNG_arrest_GFT_after_nightfall_desc: Hitting the leaders of the riots with a raid when they least expect it means that we can expect disorganized and confused rioters on the streets the following morning.
strings.GNG_arrest_CCL_after_nightfall_desc: Hitting the leaders of the riots with a raid when they least expect it means that we can expect disorganized and confused rioters on the streets the following morning.
strings.GNG_institute_anti_GFT_checkpoints_desc: Slowing down the movement of potential rioters from district to district will help our officers on the street maintain control. Unfortunately, we're also likely to round up a few innocents as we check and detain rioters.
strings.GNG_institute_anti_CCL_checkpoints_desc: Slowing down the movement of potential rioters from district to district will help our officers on the street maintain control. Unfortunately, we're also likely to round up a few innocents as we check and detain rioters.
strings.GNG_raid_GFT_printers_desc: Some of the newspapers have been printing sympathetic stories about the rioters and their fight for a fairer Guangdong. Time to shut the presses.
strings.GNG_raid_CCL_printers_desc: Some of the newspapers have been printing sympathetic stories about the rioters and their fight for a fairer Guangdong. Time to shut the presses.
strings.GNG_sic_PMC_on_GFT_desc: Asking some well-funded, well-intentioned men to go out on the streets and maintain “order” at their discretion is certainly an effective way of subduing the riots plaguing our streets. Too bad it isn't cheap.
strings.GNG_sic_PMC_on_CCL_desc: Asking some well-funded, well-intentioned men to go out on the streets and maintain “order” at their discretion is certainly an effective way of subduing the riots plaguing our streets. Too bad it isn't cheap.
strings.GNG_dispatch_reps_to_GFT: Send LegCo Reps to the £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT
strings.GNG_dispatch_reps_to_GFT_desc: People in power are often out of touch when it comes to the common man's plight. Sending some of the powerbrokers in the LegCo to negotiate with the unions is sure to build trust and defuse the situation.
strings.GNG_dispatch_reps_to_CCL: Send LegCo Reps to the £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL
strings.GNG_dispatch_reps_to_CCL_desc: People in power are often out of touch when it comes to the common man's plight. Sending some of the powerbrokers in the LegCo to negotiate with the unions is sure to build trust and defuse the situation.
strings.GNG_enforce_light_touch_districts_GFT_de: Designating certain areas for protest and trusting the protestors to remain civil by reducing the police presence goes a long way in building trust and reconciliation between us and the protestors.
strings.GNG_enforce_light_touch_districts_CCL_de: Designating certain areas for protest and trusting the protestors to remain civil by reducing the police presence goes a long way in building trust and reconciliation between us and the protestors.
strings.GNG_sway_legco_to_agree_with_GFT_measure: A briefcase of cash here and a little bit of politicking there will ensure that the £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT-friendly legislation will breeze right through the next LegCo vote.
strings.GNG_sway_legco_to_agree_with_CCL_measure: A briefcase of cash here and a little bit of politicking there will ensure that the £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL-friendly legislation will breeze right through the next LegCo vote.
strings.GNG_announce_marginal_GFT_concessions_de: A big announcement about small measures to improve the current working conditions is sure to calm the riots down, albeit at the cost of our economic growth and strength in the LegCo.
strings.GNG_announce_marginal_CCL_concessions_de: A big announcement about small measures to improve the current working conditions is sure to calm the riots down, albeit at the cost of our economic growth and strength in the LegCo.
strings.GNG_assure_investors_of_impending_crackd: “We've been negotiating with the rioters in the hopes of finding a peaceful solution that would not disrupt your businesses. We now see that such a solution is impossible, and will be taking appropriate action to arrest their leaders, and end these riots.”
strings.GNG_accept_anti_GFT_collateral_desc: Guangdong's sole goal is to be a profitable state. These rioters stand directly against the goal, and we will spare no measure, however destructive, to eliminate them.
strings.GNG_accept_anti_CCL_collateral_desc: Guangdong's sole goal is to be a profitable state. These rioters stand directly against the goal, and we will spare no measure, however destructive, to eliminate them.
strings.GNG_employ_preventative_detainment_GFT_d: You never know which union member is going to join tomorrow's riot. The easiest way to know for sure is to just put all of the union members in jail, so then there won't be a riot tomorrow.
strings.GNG_employ_preventative_detainment_CCL_d: You never know which union member is going to join tomorrow's riot. The easiest way to know for sure is to just put all of the union members in jail, so then there won't be a riot tomorrow.
strings.GNG_use_kenpeitai_interrogation_on_GFT_d: The £GNG_kenpeitai_texticon Kenpeitai supposedly have methods for making anyone talk. We wouldn't happen to know any of those methods, because we're not subversive agents threatening the economic prosperity and stability of Guangdong.
strings.GNG_use_kenpeitai_interrogation_on_CCL_d: The £GNG_kenpeitai_texticon Kenpeitai supposedly have methods for making anyone talk. We wouldn't happen to know any of those methods, because we're not subversive agents threatening the economic prosperity and stability of Guangdong.
strings.GNG_track_GFT_over_CCTV_desc: Send an order to our intelligence services to keep a constant eye on some of the more disruptive labor union members.
strings.GNG_track_CCL_over_CCTV_desc: Send an order to our intelligence services to keep a constant eye on some of the more disruptive labor union members.
strings.GNG_expand_patrols_against_GFT_desc: We need to increase our presence on the ground against the unions in order to ensure that these riots are snuffed out before they can become more problematic.
strings.GNG_expand_patrols_against_CCL_desc: We need to increase our presence on the ground against the unions in order to ensure that these riots are snuffed out before they can become more problematic.
strings.GNG_demand_calm_from_GFT_desc: Reminding the protesters that setting cars on fire and vandalizing businesses does very little in terms of building goodwill with the LegCo and our government will hopefully get a few of them to stop the destructive behavior. Hopefully.
strings.GNG_demand_calm_from_CCL_desc: Reminding the protesters that setting cars on fire and vandalizing businesses does very little in terms of building goodwill with the LegCo and our government will hopefully get a few of them to stop the destructive behavior. Hopefully.
strings.GNG_Lock_Down_GFT_Gatherings_desc: Most of the riots are organized out of the factories; we need to prevent the unions from drawing on their power base by shutting down any meetings or gatherings that are taking place in these factories.
strings.GNG_Lock_Down_CCL_Gatherings_desc: Most of the riots are organized out of the factories; we need to prevent the unions from drawing on their power base by shutting down any meetings or gatherings that are taking place in these factories.
strings.GNG_engage_GFT_wiretaps_desc: Wiretapping the unions allows our police force to get a better handle on the situation by anticipating the movements and actions of the rioters.
strings.GNG_engage_CCL_wiretaps_desc: Wiretapping the unions allows our police force to get a better handle on the situation by anticipating the movements and actions of the rioters.
strings.GNG_raid_GFT_leader_workplaces_desc: Sapping the riots of their leadership by arresting the ringleaders at work should ease the stress on our police and riot forces.
strings.GNG_raid_CCL_leader_workplaces_desc: Sapping the riots of their leadership by arresting the ringleaders at work should ease the stress on our police and riot forces.
strings.GNG_send_negotiation_feelers_to_the_GFT: Send Negotiation Feelers to the £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT
strings.GNG_send_negotiation_feelers_to_the_GFT_: If we want an agreement to be struck between us and the rioters, we need to know their negotiating position and their baseline demands. Sending some of our more moderate leaders to try and open a channel in good faith is a necessary first step in potential reconciliation.
strings.GNG_send_negotiation_feelers_to_the_CCL: Send Negotiation Feelers to the£GNG_CCL_texticon CCL
strings.GNG_send_negotiation_feelers_to_the_CCL_: If we want an agreement to be struck between us and the rioters, we need to know their negotiating position and their baseline demands. Sending some of our more moderate leaders to try and open a channel in good faith is a necessary first step in potential reconciliation.
strings.GNG_grant_a_promise_to_the_GFT: Grant a Promise to the £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT
strings.GNG_grant_a_promise_to_the_GFT_desc: Agreeing to one of the £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT's key demands will buy us some time and get angry workers off of the streets and back into the factories, even if their bosses don't agree with our decision.
strings.GNG_grant_a_promise_to_the_CCL: Grant a Promise to the £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL
strings.GNG_grant_a_promise_to_the_CCL_desc: Agreeing to one of the £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL's key demands will buy us some time and get angry workers off of the streets and back into the factories, even if their bosses don't agree with our decision.
strings.GNG_Embrace_Statical_Polling_Against_GFT: No one is saying that every union member is a rioter. But the vast majority of people that we've arrested so far for rioting on the streets have been a union member. Surely it's not a coincidence?
strings.GNG_Embrace_Statical_Polling_Against_CCL: No one is saying that every union member is a rioter. But the vast majority of people that we've arrested so far for rioting on the streets have been a union member. Surely it's not a coincidence?
strings.GNG_unplug_GFT_dissidents_from_society_d: Turns out that coordinating a “peaceful protest” when you don't have access to a landline gets real difficult, real fast.
strings.GNG_unplug_CCL_dissidents_from_society_d: Turns out that coordinating a “peaceful protest” when you don't have access to a landline gets real difficult, real fast.
strings.GNG_sic_the_fujitsu_PMC_on_the_GFT: Sic the Fujitsu PMC on the £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT
strings.GNG_sic_the_fujitsu_PMC_on_the_GFT_desc: Fujitsu has dealt with worker disturbances before, but not to this scale. Thankfully, we know a couple of people who have an incredible amount of expertise when it comes to handling a violent riot.
strings.GNG_sic_the_fujitsu_PMC_on_the_CCL: Sic the Fujitsu PMC on the £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL
strings.GNG_sic_the_fujitsu_PMC_on_the_CCL_desc: Fujitsu has dealt with worker disturbances before, but not to this scale. Thankfully, we know a couple of people who have an incredible amount of expertise when it comes to handling a violent riot.
strings.GNG_Order_Militias_to_deescalate_against: Order Deescalation of Anti-£GNG_GFT_texticon GFT Actions
We'll show the rioters some goodwill and ease off of the most aggressive measures our security forces are taking in the hopes that it will calm some of the less radical union members.
Order Deescalation of Anti-£GNG_CCL_texticon CCL Actions
We'll show the rioters some goodwill and ease off of the most aggressive measures our security forces are taking in the hopes that it will calm some of the less radical union members.
strings.GNG_beg_legco_to_compromise_with_GFT: Beg the LegCo for £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT Compromise
strings.GNG_beg_legco_to_compromise_with_GFT_des: A proposal that would see significant progress in resolving the tensions between our government and the rioters is currently stalled in the LegCo. We need to do everything in our power to make sure it passes.
strings.GNG_beg_legco_to_compromise_with_CCL: Beg the LegCo for £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL Compromise
strings.GNG_beg_legco_to_compromise_with_CCL_des: A proposal that would see significant progress in resolving the tensions between our government and the rioters is currently stalled in the LegCo. We need to do everything in our power to make sure it passes.
strings.GNG_renounce_hated_policies_for_the_GFT_: Repealing some of the policies that the rioters have specifically targeted as unfair should return a good number of them back to work and off the streets. Unfortunately, those same policies also boosted the balance sheets for every single one of our factories.
strings.GNG_renounce_hated_policies_for_the_CCL_: Repealing some of the policies that the rioters have specifically targeted as unfair should return a good number of them back to work and off the streets. Unfortunately, those same policies also boosted the balance sheets for every single one of our factories.
strings.GNG_surge_armed_police_in_GFT_district: Surge Armoured Police in £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT Districts
strings.GNG_surge_armed_police_in_GFT_district_d: The rioters are deeply entrenched in several key districts. We need to send out the armored cars and break them up before they can do more damage.
strings.GNG_surge_armed_police_in_CCL_district: Surge Armoured Police in £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL Districts
strings.GNG_surge_armed_police_in_CCL_district_d: The rioters are deeply entrenched in several key districts. We need to send out the armored cars and break them up before they can do more damage.
strings.GNG_aim_nonlethal_rounds_at_head_level_g: Leaving a physical scar as a warning to stop these rebellious acts should be more than enough to scare off the majority of rioters.
strings.GNG_aim_nonlethal_rounds_at_head_level_c: Leaving a physical scar as a warning to stop these rebellious acts should be more than enough to scare off the majority of rioters.
strings.GNG_push_back_with_armored_cars_gft: Push Back £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT with Armored Cars
strings.GNG_push_back_with_armored_cars_gft_desc: We have executives and LegCo members held up by sham roadblocks and unionists. Bulldozing both with our APCs should allow for the important people to get where they need to go.
strings.GNG_push_back_with_armored_cars_ccl: Push Back £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL with Armored Cars
strings.GNG_push_back_with_armored_cars_ccl_desc: We have executives and LegCo members held up by sham roadblocks and unionists. Bulldozing both with our APCs should allow for the important people to get where they need to go.
strings.GNG_delegate_interrogations_to_the_kenpe: Leave £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT Suspects to the £GNG_kenpeitai_texticon Kenpeitai

Our detectives are swamped with the amount of work they have on hand. Let's ask the £GNG_kenpeitai_texticon Kenpeitai for a little help in getting some answers out of the people we have in our holding cells.
Leave £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL Suspects to the £GNG_kenpeitai_texticon Kenpeitai

Our detectives are swamped with the amount of work they have on hand. Let's ask the £GNG_kenpeitai_texticon Kenpeitai for a little help in getting some answers out of the people we have in our holding cells.
strings.GNG_restrict_chinese_movement_gft: Restrict Chinese Movement in £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT Areas
strings.GNG_restrict_chinese_movement_gft_desc: It's too risky to allow the Chinese population of Guangdong to come and go as they please right now. The likelihood of them joining the riots is simply too high.
strings.GNG_restrict_chinese_movement_ccl: Restrict Chinese Movement in £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL Areas
strings.GNG_restrict_chinese_movement_ccl_desc: It's too risky to allow the Chinese population of Guangdong to come and go as they please right now. The likelihood of them joining the riots is simply too high.
strings.GNG_restrict_zhujin_movement_gft: Restrict Zhujin Movement in £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT Areas
strings.GNG_restrict_zhujin_movement_gft_desc: Just because they've worked with us in the past doesn't mean they'll continue to do so. The Zhujin cannot be trusted, and as such, we need to crack down to make sure they can't backstab us.
strings.GNG_restrict_zhujin_movement_ccl: Restrict Zhujin Movement in £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL Areas
strings.GNG_restrict_zhujin_movement_ccl_desc: Just because they've worked with us in the past doesn't mean they'll continue to do so. The Zhujin cannot be trusted, and as such, we need to crack down to make sure they can't backstab us.
strings.GNG_offer_collective_incentives_and_puni: Bestow £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT Group Rewards and Justice
A little bit of cash here and a fake promise to ease off our most aggressive policing actions should keep some of the less dedicated unionists at home instead of on the streets.
Bestow £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL Group Rewards and Justice
A little bit of cash here and a fake promise to ease off our most aggressive policing actions should keep some of the less dedicated unionists at home instead of on the streets.
strings.GNG_floodairwaves_with_anti_GFT_messagin: An ignorant populace is one that we can manipulate. Thankfully, it's not hard to paint a bunch of unionists who burn cars and antagonize our police as a bunch of hooligans who deserve no concessions from us.
strings.GNG_floodairwaves_with_anti_CCL_messagin: An ignorant populace is one that we can manipulate. Thankfully, it's not hard to paint a bunch of unionists who burn cars and antagonize our police as a bunch of hooligans who deserve no concessions from us.
strings.GNG_pay_the_underworld_to_attack_the_GFT: Pay the Underworld to Attack £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT
Giving the local Triads and Yakuza a target and ensuring proper monetary compensation is the easiest way to solve a problem in Guangdong.
strings.GNG_pay_the_underworld_to_attack_the_CCL: Pay the Underworld to Attack £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL
Giving the local Triads and Yakuza a target and ensuring proper monetary compensation is the easiest way to solve a problem in Guangdong.
strings.GNG_Disappear_GFT_family_members_desc: They always say that family is the most important thing in Guangdong. Forcing the rioters to pick between a lost cause and their families is a no brainer for many, but not for a few holdouts.
strings.GNG_Disappear_CCL_family_members_desc: They always say that family is the most important thing in Guangdong. Forcing the rioters to pick between a lost cause and their families is a no brainer for many, but not for a few holdouts.
strings.GNG_use_live_ammo_on_GFT_rioters: Use Live Ammo on £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT Rioters
strings.GNG_use_live_ammo_on_GFT_rioters_desc: If rubber bullets and tear gas don't get the message across, surely live ammo will?
strings.GNG_use_live_ammo_on_CCL_rioters: Use Live Ammo on £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL Rioters
strings.GNG_use_live_ammo_on_CCL_rioters_desc: If rubber bullets and tear gas don't get the message across, surely live ammo will?
strings.GNG_besiege_GFT_neighbourhoods_desc: The £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT are entrenched across several residential buildings. Starving them out will take time, but guarantee success.
strings.GNG_besiege_CCL_neighbourhoods_desc: The £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL are entrenched across several residential buildings. Starving them out will take time, but guarantee success.
strings.GNG_lavish_rewards_for_turncoats_gft_des: Rewarding those who have seen the foolishness of trying to stand up to the state will ensure that additional defectors continue to abandon the £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT's ranks.
strings.GNG_lavish_rewards_for_turncoats_ccl_des: Rewarding those who have seen the foolishness of trying to stand up to the state will ensure that additional defectors continue to abandon the £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL's ranks.
strings.GNG_dispatch_manchurian_hitmen_gft_desc: There really is no replacement for experience. Thankfully, we have some enforcers from £MAN_manchukuo_texticon Manchuria who are well versed in putting down riots and capturing dissidents.
strings.GNG_dispatch_manchurian_hitmen_ccl_desc: There really is no replacement for experience. Thankfully, we have some enforcers from £MAN_manchukuo_texticon Manchuria who are well versed in putting down riots and capturing dissidents.
strings.GNG_accelerate_show_trials_gft_desc: Rubber-stamping a guilty verdict for all of the leaders of these riots ensures that less time is wasted in a courtroom and more time is spent tracking down the remaining leaders.
strings.GNG_accelerate_show_trials_ccl_desc: Rubber-stamping a guilty verdict for all of the leaders of these riots ensures that less time is wasted in a courtroom and more time is spent tracking down the remaining leaders.
strings.GNG_raze_GFT_neighbourhoods_desc: The £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT have entrenched themselves across several residential buildings in a block, thinking it will buy them time and support. Unfortunately for them, we have never cared about the collateral damage. Time to call in the big guns.
strings.GNG_raze_GFT_neighbourhoods_tt: Those who seek liberation shall find liberty from life.
strings.GNG_raze_CCL_neighbourhoods_desc: The £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL have entrenched themselves across several residential buildings in a block, thinking it will buy them time and support. Unfortunately for them, we have never cared about the collateral damage. Time to call in the big guns.
strings.GNG_deport_GFT_prisoners_to_manchukuo_de: Our colony state in £MAN_manchukuo_texticon Manchukuo has a constant need for manpower in the mines and factories. It just so happens that we have a massive prisoner population that our jails can't support for much longer here...
strings.GNG_deport_GFT_prisoners_to_manchukuo_tt:
The criminals' life and liberty are forfeit.
The sooner they understand this, the better.
strings.GNG_deport_CCL_prisoners_to_manchukuo_de: Our colony state in £MAN_manchukuo_texticon Manchukuo has a constant need for manpower in the mines and factories. It just so happens that we have a massive prisoner population that our jails can't support for much longer here...
strings.GNG_divert_resources_away_from_GFT: Divert Resources Away from the £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT
strings.GNG_divert_resources_away_from_GFT_desc: We're fighting too many fires right now; the current situation demands that we reduce our efforts to keep the £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT in check.
strings.GNG_isnt_negotiating_or_dismantling_GFT: We are not attempting to dismantle or negotiate with the £GNG_GFT_texticon Guangdong Federation of Tradesmen.
strings.GNG_divert_resources_away_from_CCL: Divert Resources Away from the £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL
strings.GNG_divert_resources_away_from_CCL_desc: We're fighting too many fires right now; the current situation demands that we reduce our efforts to keep the £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL in check.
strings.GNG_isnt_negotiating_or_dismantling_CCL: We are not attempting to dismantle or negotiate with the £GNG_CCL_texticon Committee of Chinese Labor.
strings.GNG_address_the_legislative_council_desc: Giving a speech on the LegCo floor about some of the measures we've taken to get the £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL and £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT under control should calm the chamber down for a while.
strings.GNG_reassure_investors_desc: The last thing Guangdong can afford right now is for panic to cloud the judgment of the Japanese investors. We will talk to several higher-ups and assure them that everything is being done to get the situation under control.
strings.GNG_speak_to_the_japanese_consul_general: The Japanese mainland is understandably nervous about the current situation. Having a chat with the Consul General will ensure that both us and the Japanese are up to date on whatever measures are being taken to combat the riots.
strings.GNG_investigate_the_chinese_consulate_ge: Begins an effort to uncover whether or not the Chinese are aiding the rioters, and if so, how deep their support goes.
strings.GNG_the_situation_updates_desc: As much as the Chief Executive would wish time would stand still - just this once - the Riots have an inertia of their own. Take action now, before the situation escalates further...
strings.GNG_the_guangdong_terror_desc: £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL and £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT strength and radicalism have become uncontrollable. Should the Guangdong Terror take effect, they'll surely grow greater in strength and rage.
strings.GNG_riots_240_day_terror_limit_tt: £GNG_riot_strength_texticon Riot strength or £GNG_riot_radicalism_texticon radicalism must be under 60%
strings.GNG_riots_60_day_terror_limit_tt: £GNG_riot_strength_texticon Riot strength or £GNG_riot_radicalism_texticon radicalism must be under 70%
strings.GNG_GFT_dismantlement_tick_desc: The £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT must be kept weak if we are to successfully dismantle them.
strings.GNG_GFT_dismantlement_tick_tt: To continue dismantlement of the £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT, their £GNG_riot_strength_texticon strength must be under 30%
strings.GNG_CCL_dismantlement_tick_desc: The £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL must be kept weak if we are to successfully dismantle them.
strings.GNG_CCL_dismantlement_tick_tt: To continue dismantlement of the £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL, their £GNG_riot_strength_texticon strength must be under 30%
strings.GNG_Japan_Intervenes: The IJA garrison has gone silent...
strings.GNG_Japan_Intervenes_tt: We must immediately address Japan's concerns under 95%... or suffer the consequences.
strings.GNG_display_all_sony_riot_decisions_debu: DEBUG - Display All Sony Special Riot Decisions
strings.GNG_hide_all_sony_riot_decisions_debug: DEBUG - Hide All Sony Special Riot Decisions
strings.GNG_display_all_matsushita_riot_decision: DEBUG - Display All Matsushita Special Riot Decisions
strings.GNG_hide_all_matsushita_riot_decisions_d: DEBUG - Hide All Matsushita Special Riot Decisions
strings.GNG_display_all_fujitsu_riot_decisions_d: DEBUG - Display All Fujitsu Special Riot Decisions
strings.GNG_hide_all_fujitsu_riot_decisions_debu: DEBUG - Hide All Fujitsu Special Riot Decisions
strings.GNG_display_all_hitachi_riot_decisions_d: DEBUG - Display All Hitachi Special Riot Decisions
strings.GNG_hide_all_hitachi_riot_decisions_debu: DEBUG - Hide All Hitachi Special Riot Decisions
strings.GNG_China_Consulate_Investigation_Enable: DEBUG - Enable Chinese Consulate Investigation Decision
strings.GNG_isnt_reallocating_from_GFT: We are not reallocating resources from the £GNG_GFT_texticon Guangdong Federation of Tradesmen
strings.GNG_isnt_reallocating_from_CCL: We are not reallocating resources from the £GNG_CCL_texticon Committee of Chinese Labor
strings.GNG_divert_resources_away_from_GFT_tt: We will not be able to take action against the £GNG_GFT_texticon Guangdong Federation of Tradesmen for 25 days.
strings.GNG_divert_resources_away_from_CCL_tt: We will not be able to take action against the £GNG_CCL_texticon Committee of Chinese Labor for 25 days.
strings.GNG_japanese_consul_general_is_willing_t: £GNG_japanese_nation_texticon Takashima Masuo is willing to spare us some more time or favors.
strings.GNG_speak_to_the_japanese_consul_general: We will plead our case to £GNG_japanese_nation_texticon the Empire of Japan... and hope they are willing to give us more time.
strings.GNG_investigate_the_chinese_consulate_ge: If we suspect £GNG_chinese_nation_texticon the Republic of China of interfering in the Riots, then it may be worth investigating the Consulate-General... but there will be severe consequences if we are wrong.
strings.GNG_Pre_Riots_GFT_Strength_increase_tt: £GNG_zhujin_texticon Zhujin dissent against our government will become more numerous.
strings.GNG_Pre_Riots_GFT_Strength_decrease_tt: £GNG_zhujin_texticon Zhujin dissent against our government will lessen in scale.
strings.GNG_Pre_Riots_CCL_Strength_increase_tt: £GNG_chinese_texticon Chinese dissent against our government will become more numerous.
strings.GNG_Pre_Riots_CCL_Strength_decrease_tt: £GNG_chinese_texticon Chinese dissent against our government will lessen in scale.

strings.GNG_Market.1.desc:
“...I see. Keep me updated.” Chief Executive Suzuki said dryly, his expression emotionless as he hung up the phone with a clang; Sony, Matsushita, and Fujitsu's next-gen rifles wouldn't be complete in time for the Malayan conflict.

It wasn't a surprise, really. Prime Minister Ino had set up the arms contract as a political favor - something outside any reasonable procurement timeline. But Guangdong's companies weren't superhuman, and as a result the Army would have nothing to fight its actual enemies with.

There was no corruption so obvious as this. There would be a catch to fulfilling Ino's contract, Suzuki was sure, and the thought of giving Ino so much leverage? Ino, who had flailed in his shadow as Agriculture Minister while he had discussed opening the Pacific War with Tōjō?

That angered Suzuki, more than the news of the Companies' obvious ineptitude ever could. Even with corrupt means, there had to be a way to earn Japan's favor without relying on the whims of a single man.

His mind churned, considering alternatives. The Police had surplus weaponry, supplies, and vehicles, all built and maintained locally. These could be sold at a discount to Japan for use at the front - and if Japan didn't want them, then there were plenty of partners in the Sphere who would.

Perhaps there was even a way for the rifles to be useful, Suzuki thought, reaching for the phone. A detachment from the IJA garrison could conduct 'field tests' in Malaya, putting the prototypes through their paces. With any luck - a lot of luck - Guangdong might actually deliver a functional weapon to the IJA, even if the companies insisted on joint oversight of the tests.
strings.GNG_Market.1.a: ...Get me General Nagano. I have a proposal for him.
strings.GNG_Market.1_tt_1: We will begin military equipment exports to the Co-Prosperity Sphere.
strings.GNG_Market.1_tt_2: A special group will be formed for the field-testing and research of experimental weaponry.
strings.GNG_Proposals_delayed_1: The first step in changing course is acknowledging fault - if not the Chief Executive's, then at least £GNG_Hitachi_texticon Hitachi's.
strings.GNG_Proposals_delayed_2: It is far too late for an apology to suffice, much as the hardliners in the £GNG_legco_texticon Legislative Council think otherwise. What is the freedom of a few men, before the welfare of the many?
strings.GNG_Proposals_delayed_3: Penance is two things: to acknowledge sin, and to make amends. We have the money to spare.
strings.GNG_Proposals_delayed_4: If we are to stop another conflagration from consuming £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong in the future, we must make investments in its people today, ranging from offering new training to the civil service and expansions of disability pay and educational allowances.
strings.GNG_Proposals_delayed_5: If the people no longer trust the government to act in their interest, then we will offer them an ombudsman to act as an observer. But we must demand that our perspective be considered.
strings.GNG_Proposals_delayed_6: The next step for any ombudsman proposal is to give it actual, rather than nominal, independence - with equal representation for the government and dissident activists.
strings.GNG_Proposals_delayed_7: If we are to preserve any semblance of ethnic concord in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong, we must ensure that the people, whether £GNG_zhujin_texticon Zhujin or £GNG_chinese_texticon Chinese, have a real stake - of labor devoted and compensation paid - in the government bureaucracy and security forces.
strings.GNG_Proposals_delayed_8: It would be foolish to expect the dissidents to disband after tasting collective power. It is a bitter pill to swallow, but by recognizing the right to unionize for this dissident group - with the right to escalate concerns to the Chief Executive - we can better track their political activities going forward.
strings.GNG_Proposals_delayed_9: The dissident group in question will be granted special status in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's security and political framework, immune from any threat of dissolution or investigation of its activities without immediate evidence of egregious criminal activity. All action taken during the Riots, of course, are exempt from this definition.
strings.GNG_Proposals_delayed_10:
Where wrong has been done, action must be taken to make things right. It stands to reason, then, that grievous wrongs demand radical action.

The Chief Executive will pledge to extend 'privileged advocate' status to the dissident group in question, a political dispensation to extend state backing and resources in cases where demanding redress is a priority - ensuring the £GNG_zhujin_texticon Zhujin and £GNG_chinese_texticon Chinese can defend themselves in the court system, which is otherwise heavily stacked in favor of the corporations.

It is difficult to see £GNG_legco_texticon the Legislative Council - or £GNG_japanese_nation_texticon Japan - accepting this proposal.

strings.GNG_Proposals_Info:
To end the riots by negotiation, we must first craft a proposal. We have 10 possible provisions to add, each one more radical than the last. The proposal needs to consider the bargaining power of the chosen rioter group, through their £GNG_riot_strength_texticon strength and £GNG_riot_radicalism_texticon radicalism, as well as what the £GNG_legco_texticon LegCo is willing to pass, based on our £GNG_government_despair_texticon government despair. Too many concessions will also get on £GNG_japanese_nation_texticon Japan's nerves, and can lead to heightened tensions with the £GNG_japanese_frustration_texticon IJA garrison.

Tread carefully, Chief Executive.

Be careful. For £GNG_rioters_texticon rioters to accept a weak proposal, their £GNG_riot_radicalism_texticon radicalism and £GNG_riot_strength_texticon strength must both be low. For the £GNG_legco_texticon LegCo to accept significant concessions, £GNG_government_despair_texticon government despair must be high. And £GNG_japanese_frustration_texticon Japan's frustration will invaraibly increase, if we grant too many concessions...

strings.GNG_growing_hitachi_influence_desc: Through corruption and political intimidation, Hitachi is making inroads into accumulating a greater share of the LegCo.
strings.GNG_hitachi_coup_seats_tt: Less than [?35|Y0] £GNG_Hitachi_texticon Hitachi seats in the £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon LegCo.
strings.GNG_investigate_hitachi_accounts_desc: A record number of LegCo members are pledging their allegiance to Hitachi, despite the company's record books looking completely normal. Perhaps a second pass will reveal potential discrepancies?
strings.GNG_bribe_hitachi_representatives_desc: Two can always play the game of bribery in Guangdong. Whatever Hitachi's intentions may be, we can shift a little cash to certain LegCo members to get them back onto our side, not Hitachi's.
strings.GNG_threaten_hitachi_representatives_des: If cash doesn't work in Guangdong, threats of violence are another tried-and-true method of “convincing” LegCo members to align with our vision, and not Hitachi's.
strings.GNG_publish_anti_hitachi_hit_piece_desc: Whether it be through money, violence, lies, or any other sordid method, Hitachi is about to sway another member of the LegCo to their side.
strings.GNG_HC_GUI_revealed_tt:
£GNG_Hitachi_texticon Hitachi has gone too far. They will try and coup the £GNG_legco_texticon LegCo through subversive means and buying seats!
Unlocks the Hitachi's Growing Influence GUI in the £decision_icon_small decisions tab.
strings.GNG_manchukuo_race_is_on_tt: After the setback of the £GNG_Yasuda_texticon Yasuda Crisis, the race to reach a higher GDP than £MAN_manchukuo_texticon the Empire of Manchuria is in full swing.
strings.GNG_desperate_measures_manchukuo_race_tt: Due to unexpected competition, we have gotten access to desperate economic £decision_icon_small decisions underneath the Miracle on the Pearl River GUI.
strings.GNG_outraced_manchukuo_tt: £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon The State of Guangdong cheers, as the £MAN_manchukuo_texticon Empire of Manchuria lies beneath us in sheer GDP.
strings.GNG_outraced_manchukuo_sony_flavor_tt: The Gadgeteer of Guangdong and Guangdong's Superman have proven the versatility and excellence of humane capitalism, by leveraging the strength of the £GNG_zhujin_texticon Zhujin and £GNG_chinese_texticon Chinese, granting following effects:
strings.GNG_outraced_manchukuo_matsushita_flavor: The Ascendant Heir has proven the efficiency and capability of the Corporate State, by relying on the wealth of the £GNG_expats_texticon Japanese Expats and the rest of £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's populace, granting following effects:
strings.GNG_outraced_manchukuo_fujitsu_flavor_tt: The Silicon Visionary has proven the perfection and merits of the Engineer's Citadel, by leveraging the innovative spirit of the £GNG_zhujin_texticon Zhujin and competence of the Japanese Expats, granting following effects:
strings.GNG_outraced_manchukuo_hitachi_flavor_tt: The Manchurian Executive has surpassed his superiors, by perfecting the spirit of Manchurian planning, thus creating a more perfect society for the £GNG_expats_texticon Japanese Expats of £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong, granting following effects:
strings.GNG_race_with_manchukuo_on_hold_OC_tt: Due to unforeseen developments, the GDP race against the £MAN_manchukuo_texticon Empire of Manchuria is put on hold.
strings.GNG_can_investigate_chinese_consulate_ge:
The government now has the option to investigate the £GNG_chinese_nation_texticon Chinese Consulate-General's role in the Guangdong Riots via the Riots £decision_icon_small decision category.

Of course, an investigation into something this explosive may have severe consequences if mishandled...
strings.GNG_ConsulateInvestigation_Ready_tt: We are ready to begin investigating the Chinese Consulate-General - if we are ready to face the consequences.
strings.GNG_knows_more_about_song_tooltip: We learn more about Song Zhiguang...
strings.GNG_knows_more_about_wang_tooltip: We learn more about Wang Jingxu...
strings.GNG_chinainvestigation_dropped_tt: The investigation into the £GNG_chinese_nation_texticon Chinese Consulate has been dropped, and cannot be redone.
strings.GNG_basic_law_desc_0: As part of the establishment of the £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon State of Guangdong, prominent £GNG_zhujin_texticon collaborators, £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon business interests, and £GNG_expats_texticon Japanese administrators were 'invited' to join the £GNG_legco_texticon Legislative Council as a formal body operating to advise the Chief Executive and the Guangdong Civil Administration. In practice, corporate interests have flooded the chamber with bribes and favors, exercising proxy control via the £GNG_legco_texticon LegCo - forming an uneasy relationship with the Chief Executive who, even if given £GNG_japanese_nation_texticon Tokyo's backing, cannot do much without the £GNG_legco_texticon LegCo's consent.
strings.GNG_basic_law_desc_1: The £GNG_legco_texticon Legislative Council of Guangdong has been dissolved until further notice.
strings.GNG_census_ordinance_law_desc_0: Successive population censuses conducted in 1951, 1956, and 1961. The £GNG_zhujin_texticon 'Zhujin' category was tracked from the 1956 census onwards, based on occupational data, to encompass those civil servants and registered business owners deemed 'reliable' by the £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon State of Guangdong.
strings.GNG_census_ordinance_law_desc_1: For those who led £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong astray, for those who saw fit to condemn it to destruction and death - we have only military justice to dispense. All are equal in the eyes of military law - ethnicity or origin be damned.
strings.GNG_japan_sofa_law_desc_0: The 1952 Status of Forces Agreement signed between the £GNG_japanese_nation_texticon Empire of Japan and the £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon State of Guangdong outlines the duties assigned to the £GNG_japanese_frustration_texticon Imperial Japanese Army division stationed in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong. Officially serving purely as a garrison force with no statutory intelligence or domestic enforcement powers, the deficiencies in the local £GNG_police_texticon Guangdong Police and the organizational inertia of the £GNG_japanese_frustration_texticon IJA's military counterintelligence apparatus have given the £GNG_kenpeitai_texticon Kenpeitai significant say in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's security affairs.
strings.GNG_japan_sofa_law_desc_1: Following the expansion of the £GNG_police_texticon Guangdong Police Force's capabilities under £GNG_Sony_texticon Chief Executive Morita, the £GNG_kenpeitai_texticon Kenpeitai detachment of the IJA garrison force has agreed to new procedures surrounding its provision and execution of counterintelligence and law enforcement assistance in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong - though it retains some rights to assist upon consultation with the £GNG_Sony_texticon Chief Executive.
strings.GNG_japan_sofa_law_desc_2: Following the expansion of the £GNG_police_texticon Guangdong Police Force's capabilities under £GNG_Sony_texticon Chief Executive Morita, the £GNG_kenpeitai_texticon Kenpeitai detachment of the £GNG_japanese_frustration_texticon IJA garrison force has agreed to new procedures surrounding its provision and execution of counterintelligence and law enforcement assistance in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong - with no powers to interfere in local counterintelligence or law enforcement without the express request of the £GNG_Sony_texticon Chief Executive.
strings.GNG_japan_sofa_law_desc_3: The bolstering of the £GNG_police_texticon Guangdong Police with £GNG_Matsushita_texticon corporate security agents - and the abundant resources poured into the newly-formed Special Branch, answerable only to the £GNG_Matsushita_texticon Chief Executive and the Security Secretary - have helped create a complementary intelligence and law enforcement network to the £GNG_kenpeitai_texticon IJA's Kenpeitai military counterintelligence. There is no need for the working arrangements to be changed; merely that whatever the £GNG_kenpeitai_texticon Kenpeitai can do, the £GNG_police_texticon Police and £GNG_Matsushita_texticon Matsushita's men can do just as well.
strings.GNG_japan_sofa_law_desc_4: The issue was never with the number of bodies in the security forces - what use is a bloodhound without a scent to follow? But with the plethora of bugs planted in official chambers and the cameras installed on nearly every corner - and the meticulous logging of even the smallest infractions and their perpetrators, even if without their knowledge - we will have as complete a picture of crime and villainy in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong as we can. Then, and only then, can we let our men in uniform loose, far exceeding the capabilities of even £GNG_kenpeitai_texticon Japan's Kenpeitai. Their job is not to question the causality of crime - only to stamp it out wherever it rears its head.
strings.GNG_japan_sofa_law_desc_5: Extreme circumstances demand extreme measures. For their safety and for the good of public order, the £GNG_police_texticon Police shall be given the equipment and authorisation to more freely employ lethal equipment against any miscreants. Where needed, the £GNG_kenpeitai_texticon Kenpeitai and £MAN_manchukuo_texticon Manchurian 'advisors' will be asked to provide assistance.
strings.GNG_japan_sofa_law_desc_6:
The £GNG_IJA_riots_texticon Imperial Japanese Army has assumed full responsibility over security in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong for the duration of the present crisis.

All pre-existing agreements between £GNG_japanese_nation_texticon Japan and £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong are considered rescinded until further notice.
strings.GNG_labor_standards_law_desc_0: While £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong introduced labor legislation as part of a general copying of £GNG_japanese_nation_texticon Japanese-inspired legal codes as a part of its formation, the central premise of £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's existence as a playground for corporate colonialism meant that its provisions were severely weakened compared to similar legislation in the Sphere - and have largely been allowed to atrophy into irrelevance by 1962.
strings.GNG_labor_standards_law_desc_1: The Revised LSO updates the older legislation with adjusted minimum wage legislation and guaranteed rest days to bring it closer to equivalent legal codes elsewhere, as a first step towards stabilizing the volatile public situation in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong. It does not, however, have a robust enforcement system - likely at the behest of £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's major corporations.
strings.GNG_labor_standards_law_desc_2: The implementation of the Revised Labor Standards Ordinance has been delayed until further notice.
strings.GNG_labor_standards_law_desc_3: Passed under the administration of £GNG_Sony_texticon Chief Executive Morita Akio, this wide-ranging amendment to the Labor Standards Ordinance substantively updates £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's labor safety and compensation laws to be broadly comparable to those elsewhere in the Sphere - forcing all the major Companies in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong into compliance with £GNG_Sony_texticon Sony and £GNG_Cheung_Kong_texticon Cheung Kong's desired standards.
strings.GNG_labor_standards_law_desc_4: £GNG_Matsushita_texticon Chief Executive Matsushita's changes to the Labor Standards Ordinance are a step in the right direction - a very marginal, halting step. While minimum pay and the institution of working hour caps are accompanied with a closing of regulatory loopholes commonly abused in the past, the ordinance leaves much on the table in terms of worker safety and health. £GNG_Matsushita_texticon £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon £GNG_Sony_texticon £GNG_Cheung_Kong_texticon £GNG_Hitachi_texticon The Five Companies, as always, are loath to consider further action beyond this concession.
strings.GNG_morita_plan_law_desc: Someday, this pain will end - so says £GNG_Sony_texticon Morita Akio, with the £GNG_Yasuda_texticon Chief Executive acting as his guarantor.
strings.GNG_ibuka_plan_law_desc: £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong will remain a linchpin of business in the £GNG_chinese_nation_texticon Chinese mainland - so promises £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Ibuka Masaru, with the £GNG_Yasuda_texticon Chief Executive as his mouthpiece.
strings.GNG_yasuda_action_law_desc: The £GNG_Yasuda_texticon corporate giant is dead; may the £GNG_Sony_texticon £GNG_Matsushita_texticon £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon survivors grow fat from its entrails.
strings.GNG_zhujin_industrial_associations_law_d: The government actively encourages £GNG_zhujin_texticon Zhujin suppliers and manufacturers to form formal corporate alliances, bound together with mutual capital and £GNG_Cheung_Kong_texticon Cheung Kong expertise, to form a consolidated front against the £GNG_expats_texticon Japanese-dominated Companies.
strings.GNG_integrated_corporate_networks_law_de: The government has created an office to identify £GNG_zhujin_texticon Zhujin firms in related industries and provide the resources necessary to consolidate them voluntarily - creating larger, stronger firms to stand against the £GNG_expats_texticon Japanese tycoons.
strings.GNG_future_fund_law_desc: The government has created a state investment fund tasked with investing a set amount of seed capital and ensuring sufficient returns to allow independent financing of development projects for the people of £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong.
strings.GNG_corporate_impact_fund_law_desc: The government has insisted that the corporations contribute to a 'social impact' fund that will help defray the expenses of welfare projects for £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's most needy. Of course, the corporates have demanded some oversight over the use of their money.
strings.GNG_prevention_hotlines_law_desc: The government has allocated funding for hotlines to be set up and advertised to the general population to provide a sympathetic ear to anyone considering ending their lives - in the hopes that even if everyone cannot be saved, someone may be.
strings.GNG_water_purity_regulations_law_desc: New regulations have been put into place to ensure potable water supplies in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong meet minimum standards of purity to prevent the spread of waterborne disease, with follow-on annexes planned to control the treatment and disposal of industrial wastewater.
strings.GNG_air_quality_regulations_law_desc: New regulations have been mandated to control the emission of industrial pollutants in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's factories upwind of major population centers. Follow-up legislation is being considered to govern the emission of harmful substances in all factories and in major population centers.
strings.GNG_cheung_kung_public_housing_law_desc: The government has embarked on an ambitious campaign of public housing construction, aimed at clearing out the ubiquitous squatter villages in the £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Three Pearls and relocating £GNG_chinese_texticon workers to more spacious, safe, and controllable apartment blocks that benefit from public transportation access.
strings.GNG_sony_scholarship_program_law_desc: The government has announced funding of continuing education for the brightest of £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's students under £GNG_Sony_texticon Sony and £GNG_Cheung_Kong_texticon Cheung Kong tutelage- whether to study electrical engineering or business.
strings.GNG_localized_civil_service_law_desc: The government has decreed that £GNG_zhujin_texticon Cantonese will be accorded full status as a second official language for £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong - both bringing the government in accord with the language of its residents and opening the door for more widespread local participation in government institutions.
strings.GNG_semi_localized_civil_service_law_des: The government has offered to recognize £GNG_zhujin_texticon Cantonese as a de facto working language of government in local administrative affairs - but official texts and legislation will continue to be conducted with £GNG_expats_texticon Japanese as the primary language, administered at the highest levels by £GNG_expats_texticon Japanese-trained administrators.
strings.GNG_corruption_advisory_board_law_desc: The £GNG_Sony_texticon Chief Executive has set up an advisory commission on corruption in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong to investigate and probe suspected incidents of £GNG_corruption_yen_texticon malfeasance in the government of £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong. The commission will have representation from the senior corporations in the £GNG_legco_texticon Legislative Council.
strings.GNG_inspector_general_law_desc: The £GNG_legco_texticon Legislative Council has established an independent Inspector-General's office to audit and investigate instances of corruption within the government - reporting to the £GNG_legco_texticon Legislative Council itself on all matters.
strings.GNG_icac_law_desc: The Independent Commission Against Corruption is established to operate fully independently of both the £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong Civil Administration and the £GNG_legco_texticon Legislative Council, accountable solely to the £GNG_Sony_texticon Chief Executive - with powers of investigation and arrest for cases of £GNG_corruption_yen_texticon corruption in the government at all levels.
strings.GNG_sony_makao_stanley_ho_law_desc: The £GNG_legco_texticon Legislative Council has awarded a license to effectively monopolize the gambling trade in Makao under £GNG_triads_texticon Mr. Stanley Ho, the Financial Secretary of £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong.
strings.GNG_sony_makao_hideki_law_desc: The £GNG_legco_texticon Legislative Council has awarded a license to effectively monopolize the gambling trade in Makao under £GNG_yakuza_texticon Mr. Yokoi Hideki, a prominent £GNG_expats_texticon Japanese businessman in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong.
strings.GNG_executive_accountability_law_desc: No more will executives be free from prosecution for the egregious crimes of their employees. For the most egregious abuses, a company's leadership is just as accountable as its lowest members for gross, systemic violations of the law.
strings.GNG_accelerated_urbanization_law_desc: The future of £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong inevitably lies in industry - and the concentration of labor with capital has both been the time-honored way of boosting economic output, and the future that £GNG_Matsushita_texticon Matsushita will wholeheartedly embrace. We shall provide the machines, and £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong shall provide its people.
strings.GNG_limited_relocation_benefits_law_desc: Even if £GNG_Matsushita_texticon Matsushita's vision of the future inevitably involves uprooting rural communities to feed the urban factories of £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong, we can massage the message to be less disruptive. An urban life promises modernity, work, and pay - a promise of 'freedom' to those who would otherwise be bound to unproductive backwaters.
strings.GNG_the_three_pearls_law_desc: As the next step of £GNG_Matsushita_texticon Matsushita's vision for £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong, the traditional division of economic activity of the Three Pearls - Kōshū, Makao, and Honkon - will be pursued to their logical endpoints. £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong exists to feed the hunger and serve the whims of the Pearls - and the world shall be blinded by their light, illuminated by £GNG_Matsushita_texticon Matsushita's brilliance.
strings.GNG_patchwork_budget_law_desc: Whether it by sealing the cracks in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's budget or leaning on our £GNG_japanese_nation_texticon Japanese backers to put their money where their mouth is, £GNG_Matsushita_texticon Matsushita has managed to stabilise £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's finances without having to step on the Companies' vested interests in a £GNG_legco_texticon LegCo ordinance.
strings.GNG_subordinated_legco_law_desc: Even in its early steps, £GNG_Matsushita_texticon Matsushita has made clear his intent to see the £GNG_legco_texticon LegCo and its Companies ultimately bend the knee to their master. There is no room in the £GNG_legco_texticon LegCo, or the government, for those who are not willing to recognise £GNG_Matsushita_texticon Matsushita as the head honcho amongst them - not even £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Ibuka, who will learn to accept his place.
strings.GNG_first_among_equals_law_desc: £GNG_Matsushita_texticon Matsushita understands - as much as he may desire otherwise - that his position depends on extracting favors and alliances with the £GNG_legco_texticon Five Companies in the Legislative Council. They will see the benefits of working with the £GNG_Matsushita_texticon Chief Executive - and understand what might befall them if they don't.
strings.GNG_restricted_civil_service_law_desc: In the interests of public order and good government, £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong nationals of purely £GNG_chinese_texticon Chinese origin (as defined in self-declared census status) will continue to be barred from serving in the civil service in favour of a core of £GNG_zhujin_texticon Zhujin and £GNG_expats_texticon Japanese bureaucrats. The civil service will be small, but it will make do.
strings.GNG_semi_restricted_civil_service_law_de: For addressing the manpower needs in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's expanded government, individuals of ethnic £GNG_chinese_texticon Chinese descent (as defined in self-declared census status) will be permitted to apply and work in the most junior positions in the civil service. Leadership positions will remain restricted to £GNG_zhujin_texticon Zhujin and £GNG_expats_texticon Japanese bureaucrats.
strings.GNG_corporate_framework_law_desc: Under £GNG_Matsushita_texticon Matsushita's direct guidance, government employees will no longer be barred from holding secondary positions in private enterprise. This, of course, has the impact of allowing £GNG_Matsushita_texticon Matsushita employees to openly assume positions in the civil service, directing critical funds and services for the benefit of £GNG_Matsushita_texticon Matsushita Electric.
strings.GNG_formal_corporate_separation_law_desc: £GNG_Matsushita_texticon Chief Executive Matsushita has maintained the formal separation between the £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong Civil Administration and the corporation of £GNG_Matsushita_texticon Matsushita Electric, keeping the two organisations separate in staffing and resources. However, the 'informal' input of £GNG_Matsushita_texticon Matsushita executives on government policy remains pervasive - aligning government priorities increasingly with corporate objectives.
strings.GNG_matsushita_life_law_desc: A hybrid marketing and public health campaign by both the £GNG_Matsushita_texticon Matsushita Electric company and the £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong civil service, aimed at promoting several policy initiatives to both increase worker efficiency and address several quality of life concerns - namely, persistently high rates of self-directed employee deaths and occupational illness.
strings.GNG_triad_quiescence_law_desc: After questioning by the £GNG_Matsushita_texticon Chief Executive and the £GNG_police_texticon Police, £GNG_triads_texticon Stanley Ho has 'agreed' to reduce the overt activities of the £GNG_triads_texticon Triads in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong - giving our security forces more room to operate.
strings.GNG_yakuza_quiescence_law_desc: After questioning by the £GNG_Matsushita_texticon Chief Executive and the £GNG_police_texticon Police, £GNG_yakuza_texticon Yokoi HIdeki has 'agreed' to reduce the overt activities of the £GNG_yakuza_texticon Yakuza in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong - giving our security forces more room to operate.
strings.GNG_emergency_powers_law_desc: The £GNG_Matsushita_texticon Chief Executive is vested with emergency executive powers to crush £GNG_CCL_texticon £GNG_GFT_texticon rioters and restore order in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong, for as long as is required. The £GNG_legco_texticon Legislative Council has waived its oversight powers for the duration of the emergency.
strings.GNG_standardize_zhujin_identity_law: General Law on the Standardization of £GNG_zhujin_texticon Zhujin Identity
strings.GNG_standardize_zhujin_identity_law_desc: Criteria for £GNG_zhujin_texticon Zhujin status, whether for new applications or renewals, shall pivot away from ideological chaff and towards more quantifiable measures - education, registered profits, or in certain cases exceptional merit - such that our prized middle class can be something better, something more substantial than a swirl of undefined human mass behind faulty legal codes and nebulous jargon.
strings.GNG_streamlining_civil_service_law_desc: The civil services is both bloated with vested interests - and filled with incompetent hacks. We must remake it in our own image if £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong is to resemble anything close to what we desire, regardless of the cries to show mercy.
strings.GNG_industrial_rationalization_law_desc: £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Chief Executive Ibuka is not opposed to competition and market principles at work in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong. He simply wants to speed it along, as it were - so that £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon those most deserving can get down to what they do best.
strings.GNG_incipient_automation_law_desc: Where a machine will do where a person once was, £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Fujitsu shall endeavor to employ a machine. Machines, after all, make less rote errors than humans - humans that can best be employed for thinking and executing tasks beyond the reach of basic computer programming.
strings.GNG_computing_standards_law_desc: To have a multitude of systems at play from different vendors in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's civil service is an invitation to chaos and disorder, especially if the systems no longer are fit for purpose and must be replaced. To ensure scalability in the future, £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Fujitsu will take full control over the installation of electronic and computing devices throughout the £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong Civil Administration - and aggressively suggest that £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's firms do the same.
strings.GNG_rationalized_land_development_law_de: Every place has a purpose under heaven - and so shall it be with £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong. Villages on mineral deposits shall be excavated; urban centres best positioned for new factories shall be demolished. The land shall adapt to serve £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Fujitsu best.
strings.GNG_the_finest_minds_law_desc: Those who stand to provide the most for £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Fujitsu's designs - its engineers, its innovators, and its pioneers, regardless of origin - deserve to do their work in peace, with as many resources as they require. They will have dedicated research parks, funded lavishly from a £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Fujitsu committee designed to direct government funding to where it is most needed.
strings.GNG_trademark_ordinance_law_desc: All that is discovered in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong shall benefit £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Fujitsu - if not now, then eventually.
strings.GNG_organized_labor_ordinance_law_desc: Each worker shall receive exactly what they deserve and are capable of. £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Fujitsu is, after all, in the business of enabling the worker to pursue excellence - and it is no business of the state to care for those who are lacking.
strings.GNG_education_ordinance_law_desc: Fools assume the future comes as certainly as tomorrow's dawn. It will only come to those who are prepared to seize it - from childhood, if necessary. Those who prove themselves inquisitive and capable, £GNG_chinese_texticon regardless of their origins, will find they have a place in £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Fujitsu's £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong.
strings.GNG_zoning_ordinance_law_desc: Excellence is a way of life. And it is not enough to be taught or given the tools to live it - instead, the very foundations of £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's geography itself will be uprooted and improved, so that maximum efficiency and output can be achieved with minimum interruptions or distractions.
strings.GNG_triads_expunged_law_desc: With the success of £GNG_yakuza_texticon Yokoi Hideki and £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Chief Executive Ibuka's plans, Stanley Ho and his £GNG_triads_texticon Triads will no longer be a blight on £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong.
strings.GNG_survival_of_the_fittest_law_desc: The £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Chief Executive's insistence that only the most fitting, the most deserving, will survive in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong has been borne out in the Oil Crisis - the government has extended minimal assistance, letting the Crisis accelerate the work of capitalism's invisible hand.
strings.GNG_lifting_all_boats_law_desc: Those who have survived and thrived in £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Chief Executive Ibuka's £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong clearly have something to offer. Even as we extol the virtues of the gifted and the hardworking, we recognise that the worthy should not be penalised for factors outside their control.
strings.GNG_monument_to_elitism_law_desc: Only those who share £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Chief Executive Ibuka's vision are worthy to stand by his side as his lieutenants. Only they have seen the future - and everyone else can wallow in their past, outside the halls of the £GNG_legco_texticon Legislative Council.
strings.GNG_benevolent_executive_law_desc: The hardest path has no intrinsic worth of its own. £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Chief Executive Ibuka recognises that even as his successes speak for themselves, he must turn to the other Tycoons to ward away any failures that may come from the Oil Crisis.
strings.GNG_visionary_unbowed_law_desc:
In this hour of crisis, £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Chief Executive Ibuka stands alone.

By guile, by strength, and by intellect alone shall the visionary stand against the reactionary forces that cling to the past. His dream shall be £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's dream, its destiny - and he shall not look back.
strings.GNG_ibuka_revelation_law_desc:
How much has Ibuka let pass by unnoticed in pursuit of a dream - a mirage? Having spent over a decade in the single-minded pursuit of an ideal, only to find dust gathering at his feet.

He finds himself alone - and with only himself to blame.
strings.GNG_ibuka_future_law_desc:
Where £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Fujitsu is going, it needs no detractors.

Ibuka Masaru shall face the future alone - without distraction or interruption.

It is time for the voices of the past to stay silent - forever.
strings.GNG_emergency_regulations_ordinance_law_:
The state of emergency that has forced £GNG_Hitachi_texticon Hitachi to assume control of the £GNG_legco_texticon Legislative Council shall be extended indefinitely, with full executive powers vested solely in £GNG_Hitachi_texticon Chief Executive Komai.

All other legislation has been suspended unless otherwise noted.
strings.GNG_anomalous_wire_transfers_law_desc: Wire and bank transfer records indicate a significant influx of funds originating from the £MAN_manchukuo_texticon Empire of Manchuria. The fact that these inflows cluster around key £GNG_legco_texticon Legislative Council voting dates is surely coincidence.
strings.GNG_disinformation_relief_ordinance_law_: The truth shall set us all free - and £GNG_Hitachi_texticon Hitachi determines what the truth is, it really is that simple. Anyone who dares say otherwise, has done us the favor of declaring themselves a target.
strings.GNG_financial_reorganization_law_desc: Those companies that are too weak to stand on their own shall be subsumed into £GNG_Hitachi_texticon Hitachi to better serve its interests - and if it does not serve £GNG_Hitachi_texticon Hitachi's interests, then they will be shuttered permanently. There will be no waste, no extraneous activity, in Komai's £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong.
strings.GNG_hitachis_mercy_law_desc: £GNG_Hitachi_texticon Hitachi is a merciful master, with a patient disposition. It does not care if companies - particularly those larger, important ones - do not submit themselves to £GNG_Hitachi_texticon Hitachi's prerogatives immediately. We merely ask that they keep our interests in mind on their boards.
strings.GNG_fujitsu_exemptions_law_desc: While we care nothing for the nameless masses and companies in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong, there is one company that we would rather keep at our side until the last moment - Ibuka Masaru's £GNG_Fujitsu_texticon Fujitsu. The company is large enough - and its leader obstinate enough - that keeping him closer is more preferable than the trouble of disposing of them. For now.
strings.GNG_manchuria_security_arrangement_law_d: Those who are too troublesome for £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong to keep in its borders without causing more outrage, will soon find themselves wishing they'd stayed quiet. Deportation, isolation, and forced labor in £MAN_manchukuo_texticon Manchuria does wonders to improve compliance in recalcitrant prisoners.
strings.GNG_political_sentences_law_desc: Dissent has never been welcome in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong; we merely took the step of making it official. Those who have a problem with £GNG_Hitachi_texticon Hitachi can take their chances saying it again in £MAN_manchukuo_texticon Manchukuo.
strings.GNG_corporate_subordination_law_desc: Why should any corporation refuse the offer to be part of a greater whole - £GNG_Hitachi_texticon Hitachi's whole - than to suffer alone? Even if the major Companies survive, that does not mean we should tolerate the existence of anyone else. Only then can we crush the other tycoons through sheer brute force.
strings.GNG_matsushitas_lifeline_law_desc: £GNG_Matsushita_texticon Matsushita is a large company - too large to dismantle on its own - but it is predictable. It is pliable, so long as the right incentives are presented - and pliable men are far more easy to break to our will than stubborn men.
strings.GNG_hsinking_connection_law_desc: We shall keep £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong open for all capital - not just £GNG_japanese_nation_texticon Japan , but £MAN_manchukuo_texticon Manchuria as well. There is no other suitable way for us to reward our closest backers in the north - and those who object may drown in the face of the flood we unleash.
strings.GNG_hitachi_ecosystem_law_desc: As £GNG_Hitachi_texticon Hitachi expands to encompass as much commercial activity in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong as it can, it delegates the spaces of the economy it cannot be bothered to dominate itself to 'trusted' associates - almost all incorporated in £MAN_manchukuo_texticon Manchuria, the only true indicator of loyalty in Komai's £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong.
strings.GNG_manchurian_security_detachments_law_: At the request of the £GNG_Hitachi_texticon Chief Executive - and happily approved by authorities in £MAN_manchukuo_texticon Manchuria - corporate security officials and police detachments from £MAN_manchukuo_texticon Manchukuo have been dispatched to augment the £GNG_police_texticon local Police in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong, with the authority to act independently if needed.
strings.GNG_GFT_compact_law_desc: A compact has been reached with the £GNG_GFT_texticon Guangdong Federation of Tradesmen with the £GNG_legco_texticon LegCo's assent, promising reforms in exchange for the £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT desisting from further protest.
strings.GNG_CCL_compact_law_desc: A compact has been reached with the £GNG_CCL_texticon Committee of Chinese Labor with the £GNG_legco_texticon LegCo's assent, promising reforms in exchange for the £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL desisting from further protest.
strings.GNG_riots_GFT_apology_law_desc:
With deepest shame? With sincere regret?

There are infinite permutations of words available, yet none are assured of making amends to the £GNG_zhujin_texticon Zhujin for our broken promises - the sundering of whatever hope they had of making a life in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong.

But we must try.
strings.GNG_riots_CCL_apology_law_desc:
With deepest shame? With sincere regret?

There are infinite permutations of words available, yet none are assured of assuaging the pain of the £GNG_chinese_texticon Chinese left dead by the siege of £GNG_Hitachi_texticon Hitachi's factories - the spark that sent £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong careening into anarchy.

But we must make a start.
strings.GNG_GFT_restitution_law_desc: Money cannot salve all wounds, or buy back all of what was lost. But money can ease the pain - and for the £GNG_zhujin_texticon Zhujin of the £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT, provide a promise of something better.
strings.GNG_CCL_restitution_law_desc:
Money cannot fill the empty spaces in the hearts and lives of £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's £GNG_chinese_texticon Chinese residents, or restore the dignity uprooted over two decades of uncaring pain.

But it is a start.
strings.GNG_state_ombudsman_law_desc: Admitting fault, admitting mistakes, is the easy part. None of it will stick if there is no credible attempt to prevent it from happening again - a promise that the government has made via the formation of a state ombudsman investigating accusations of state and corporate abuse. It is open to public input - but staffed by the government and its corporate representatives.
strings.GNG_GFT_independent_ombudsman_law_desc:
It is not enough to admit fault - there must be a process to prevent harm and abuse from repeating itself, separate from the organs most likely to perpetrate said harm.

On the advice of the £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT, the government has established an independent ombudsman for investigating abuses with equal participation from the £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT's representatives.
strings.GNG_CCL_independent_ombudsman_law_desc:
It is not enough to admit fault - there must be a process to prevent harm and abuse from repeating itself, separate from the organs most likely to perpetrate said harm.

On the advice of the £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL, the government has established an independent ombudsman for investigating abuses with equal participation from the £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL's representatives.
strings.GNG_both_independent_ombudsman_law_desc:
It is not enough to admit fault - there must be a process to prevent harm and abuse from repeating itself, separate from the organs most likely to perpetrate said harm.

The government has committed to providing both the £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT and the £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL representation on the independent ombudsman - ensuring that grievances are fairly heard from all segments of £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's society, without fear or favor.
strings.GNG_GFT_affirmative_action_law_desc: The state shall make provision for the preferential hiring of £GNG_zhujin_texticon Zhujin representatives to positions in the £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon state bureaucracy and £GNG_police_texticon security forces - so that they may have a stake in government.
strings.GNG_CCL_affirmative_action_law_desc: The state shall make provision for the preferential hiring of £GNG_chinese_texticon Chinese representatives to positions in the £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon state bureaucracy and £GNG_police_texticon security forces - so that they may have a stake in government.
strings.GNG_GFT_union_rights_law_desc: The government shall codify and sanctify the role of the £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT as a labor union, with protections for participating in industrial action, in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's society.
strings.GNG_CCL_union_rights_law_desc: The government shall codify and sanctify the role of the £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL as a labor union, with protections for participating in industrial action, in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's society.
strings.GNG_GFT_protected_status_law_desc: The existence of the £GNG_GFT_texticon Guangdong Federation of Tradesmen will be fully protected as an umbrella representative association for £GNG_zhujin_texticon Zhujin businesses and workers in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong, written into the Basic Law as a significant part of £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's political life.
strings.GNG_CCL_protected_status_law_desc: The existence of the £GNG_CCL_texticon Committee of Chinese Labor will be fully protected as an umbrella representative association for £GNG_chinese_texticon Chinese laborers in £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong, written into the Basic Law as a significant part of £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's political life.
strings.GNG_GFT_priveleged_advocate_law_desc: All £GNG_zhujin_texticon Zhujin members of the £GNG_GFT_texticon Guangdong Federation of Tradesmen have the unconditional right to seek legal representation from the £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT in any disputes they may become party to, incorporating the £GNG_GFT_texticon GFT into £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's legal system to defend £GNG_zhujin_texticon Zhujin interests.
strings.GNG_CCL_priveleged_advocate_law_desc: All £GNG_chinese_texticon Chinese members of the £GNG_CCL_texticon Committee of Chinese Labor have the unconditional right to seek legal representation from the £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL in any disputes they may become party to, incorporating the £GNG_CCL_texticon CCL into £GFX_GNG_Guangdong_texticon Guangdong's legal system to defend £GNG_chinese_texticon Chinese interests.
strings.GNG_IJA_martial_law_desc:
All legislation previously in effect has been rescinded with immediate effect.

Supreme executive authority has been vested in the £GNG_IJA_riots_texticon Imperial Japanese Army for the duration of the present crisis.
strings.GNG_end_of_the_pearl_river_dream_law: £GNG_IJA_riots_texticon The End of the Silicon Dream
strings.GNG_end_of_the_pearl_river_dream_law_des:
Money is ephemeral, an intoxicating temptation that deludes men into believing power derives from anything other than the barrel of a gun.

How wrong they were, for their Midas hands cracked before our Hearts of Iron.
strings.GNG_fujitsu_modern_police_ordinance_law_: Pay no heed to those who would claim crime is a matter of individual decision and isolated circumstance. Like any other phenomenon, it can be cataloged, systematized, and statistically understood - and dealt with accordingly.
strings.GNG_fujitsu_anti_corruption_ordinance_la: Daylight is the best disinfectant - and if the Legislative Council disagrees with our proposal to put them under constant surveillance on the floor and in their offices, well - they have nothing to fear, if they have nothing to hide.
